prakāśakīya vaktavya
prātaḥsmaraṇīya pūjya ācārya śāṃtisāgarajī mahārājane jinavāṇī mātākī sevā evaṃ usake prasārake jisa kāryako hameṃ soṃpā thā, usakā hama yathāśakti nirvāha karate ā rahe haiṃ | jaisā ki ācārya mahārājakā ādeśa thā, hama ucca koṭike siddhāntagranthoṃke prakāśanake liye yathāsambhava prayatnaśīla avaśya haiṃ aura yaha usī prayatnakā sundara phala hai jo paṭakhaṇḍāgama jaisā mahattvapūrṇa siddhāntagrantha isa saṃsthā dvārā prakāśita hokara āja pāṭhakoṃke hāthoṃmeṃ pahuṃca rahā hai | isameṃ hama kahāṃ taka saphala huye haiṃ, yaha to svādhyāyapremī hī niścita kareṃge, kiṃtu phira bhī hamārā khyāla hai ki aba takake prakāśanoṃmeṃ yaha apanī alaga hī viśeṣatā rakhatā hai|
tīnoṃ siddhāntagranthoṃke tāmrapatroṃke ūpara utkīrṇa ho jānepara ācārya mahārājane unake mūla mātrako hiṃdī anuvādake sātha prakāśita karānekī icchā vyakta kī thī aura tadanusāra unhoṃne prathama siddhāntagrantha ṣaṭakhaṇḍāgamake kāryako sampanna karanekā ādeśa bhī śrī. nemacanda devacanda śāha solāpurakī suputrī bāla bra. śrī. sumatibāījī nyāya-kāvyatīrtha, saṃcālikā śrī rā. di. jaina śrāvikāśrama solāpura, ko de diyā thā | hameṃ isakā viśeṣa harṣa hai ki usake isa rūpameṃ pūrṇa ho jānepara ācārya mahārājakī uparyukta icchā pūrṇa ho rahī hai |
isa granthake prakāśanārtha śrī. śeṭha hirācanda talakacandajī bārāmatīne 4001 kī ārthika sahāyatā pradāna kī hai| isake liye hama unake atiśaya ābhārī haiṃ | granthake sampādana aura prakāśanameṃ jina vidvānoṃ evaṃ saṃsthāoṃkā hameṃ sahayoga prāpta huā hai una sabakā hama hṛdayase ābhāra mānate haiṃ |
vālacanda devacanda śāha bī. e. ( saṃsthāke ṭūsṭiyoṃkī orase )

śrī ā. śāṃ. jinavāṇī jīrṇoddhāraka saṃsthā, phalaṭaṇakā
saṃkṣipta paricaya
śreyaḥpadmavikāsavāsaramaṇiḥ syādvādarakṣāmaṇiḥ saṃsāroragadarpagāruḍamaṇirbhavyaughacintāmaṇiḥ | āśāntākṣayaśāntimuktimahiṣīsīmantamuktāmaṇiḥ
śrīmaddevaśiromaṇivijayate śrīvardhamāno jinaḥ || ācārya śrī śāntisāgara mahārājake jīvana-caritra aura jīvana sandeśase sakala digambara jaina samāja bhalībhāṃti paricita hai | ācāryaśrīkā tapomaya pavitra jīvana paraga gauravaśālī rahā hai | unake jīvana-kālameṃ agaṇita dharmakāryokī sampannatā aura vividha saṃsthāoṃkī sthāpanā huī hai | unhoṃne apane samādhi-kālameṃ svātmānubhava tathā āgamake anusāra jīvanakī saphalatāke lie apūrva upadeśa dekara saṃsārako sukha-śāntikā mārga-darśana kiyā hai, jisameṃ pahalā ātma-cintanakā aura dūsarā nirantara āgama-rakṣā tathā jñāna-dānakā pāvana sulabha mārga batalāyā hai | ātma-cintanakā mārga vyaktigata hai, phira bhī isa mārgapara calane ke pahale ātmaviśvāsake lie āgamakā adhyayana āvaśyaka hai | sarva sādhāraṇako āgamakī prāpti sulabha ho, isake lie ācāryaśrīne samaya-samayapara apane upadeśoṃ dvārā amūlya śāstra pradāna karanekī preraṇā kī aura usake phala-svarūpa paramapūjya cāritracakravartī śrī 108 ācārya śāntisāgara digambara jaina jinavāṇī jīrṇoddhāraka saṃsthākā janma huā| ...
isī samaya ācāryaśrīko jñāta huā ki digambara sampradāya ke mahāmānya aura prācīnatama grantharāja śrī ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgama ( dhavala ), kasāyapāhuḍa ( jayadhavala ) aura mahābaṃdha ( mahādhavala ) kī eka mātra mūḍabidrīmeṃ upalabdha tāḍapatrīya pratiyāṃ jīrṇa-śīrṇa hotī jā rahī haiṃ, unameṃse eka granthake to pāṃca hajāra śloka naṣṭa ho gaye haiṃ, aura śeṣake patra hāthameṃ uṭhāte hī ṭūṭakara bikharane lage haiṃ | yaha jñāta hote hī ācāryaśrīkā hṛdaya dravībhūta ho uṭhā aura aharniśa yaha vicāra manameṃ cakkara lagāne lagā ki kisa prakāra isa amūlya āgama-nidhikī rakṣā kī jāya, jisase ki ye grantharāja yuga-yugānta taka surakṣita raha sakeṃ | unhoṃne apanā āśaya samājake kucha pramukha logoṃke sāmane. vyakta kiyā ki yadi ina grantharājoṃko tāmrapatroṃpara utkīrṇa karā diyā jāya, to yaha amūlya śrutanidhi yuga-yugake lie surakṣita ho jāya | tadanusāra ukta kāryako sampanna karaneke lie “ pa. pū. cā. ca. śrī 108 ā. śāntisāgara di. jaina jinavāṇī jīrṇoddhāraka " saṃsthākī sthāpanā vīra saṃ. 2470 ke paryuṣaṇa parvapara śrī siddhakṣetra kunthalagiripara huī|

tatpaścāt vīra saṃ. 2 471 ke phālguna māsameṃ ācāryaśrīke bārāmatī padārpaṇa karanepara ukta saṃsthākī niyamāvalī banavākara kānūnake anusāra rajiṣṭrī karā dī gaī | adhikārī va anubhavī vidvānoṃkī dekha-rekhameṃ tīnoṃ siddhāntagranthoṃko tāmrapatroṃpara utkīrṇa karāyā gayā | utkīrṇa tāmrapatroṃkā • ākāra 8x13 iṃca hai| tīnoṃ siddhāntagranyoṃke tāmrapatroṃkī saṃkhyā 2664 hai, jinakā vajana lagabhaga 50 mana hai| sātha hī sātha tīnoṃ granthoṃkī pāṃca-pāṃca sau pratiyāṃ bhī mudrita karāyī gaī haiṃ, jinakā upayoga adhikārī vidvān aura svādhyāya premī pāṭhaka cirakāla taka karate raheṃge| aisā mahān kārya jaina samājameṃ to kyā, anya bhāratīya yā videśīya samājameṃ bhī abhī taka nahīṃ huā hai|
__uparyukta tīnoṃ siddhāntagrantha hindī anuvāda ke sātha vibhinna saṃsthāoṃse prakāśita ho cuke haiṃ, aura prastuta grantha ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgama hindī anuvādake sātha apane mūla rūpameṃ pāṭhakoṃke samakṣa upasthita hai, jisakī prastāvanāmeṃ ina grantharājoṃkā paricaya diyā hī gayā hai, ataḥ use yahāṃ denā punarukta hī hogā|
vīra saṃ0 2480 meṃ ācāryaśrīkā cāturmāsa phalaṭaṇameṃ huā thā| isa samaya ācāryaśrīna āgamasaṃrakṣaṇa aura jñānadānakī eka racanātmaka yojanā samājake sāmane rakhī | phalasvarūpa tāmrapatrotkīrṇa grantharājoṃkī surakṣāke lie śrī 1008 candraprabhake maṃdirajīmeṃ ācāryaśrīke hīrakamahotsavake samaya saṃkalita nidhimeṃse bace hue karība bīsa hajāra rupayoṃse nayā bhavana banavāyā gayā, jisameṃ yaha samasta śrutanidhi atyanta surakṣita rūpase rakhī gaī hai|
sallekhanā aṃgīkāra karate hī ācāryaśrīke upadeśoṃmeṃ eka mahān parivartana dṛṣṭigocara hone lagā | aba taka ācāryaśrī gṛhasthoṃke kalyāṇake lie jinabiṃba, jināgāra aura pūjādi puṇyakāryake lie adhikatara upadeśa dete the| kintu aba āpane anubhava kiyā ki śāstra-svādhyāyake vinā dharma-śraddhāna dṛḍha़ nahīṃ rahegā aura śāstroṃkī sulabhatāke vinā svādhyāya nahīṃ ho sakegā, ataḥ pratyeka grāmake jinamaṃdiroṃmeṃ āgamoṃkī sulabhatā honī cāhie| svādhyāyake sādhanabhūta śāstra yadi sānuvāda hoṃ, to janatāko bhārī lābha hogā| ataḥ svādhyāyapremiyoṃko śāstra vinā mūlya milanā cāhie | ācāryaśrīke ukta udgāroṃse preraṇā pākara phalaṭaṇa-nivāsī di. jaina samājane pūrva saṃsthāpita pa. pū. cā. ca. śrī 108 ā. śāntisāgara di. jaina jinavāṇī jīrṇoddhāraka saṃsthāse pramāṇita śrutabhāṇḍāra aura granthaprakāśana-samitikī sthāpanā kī| isa saṃsthāke nirmāṇameṃ tathā vikāsakāryameṃ phalaṭaṇake sabhī bhāiyoṃne utsāhapūrvaka sahayoga diyā | jina uddeśyoṃko lekara yaha saṃsthā sthāpita huī, ve isa prakāra haiṃ
(1) prācīna tathā jīrṇoddhāra kiye gaye śrī dhavalādi grantharāja isa saṃsthāke dvārā surakṣita rakkhe jāya aura unakī surakṣākā kārya nirantara phalaṭaṇa-vāsiyoṃkī orase unhīṃkī jimmedārīpara kiyā jāya |

dātāra - nāma
śrī gaṃgārāma kāmacaṃda dośī, phalaṭaṇa śrī hirācaṃda kevalacaṃda dośī, phalaṭaṇa śrī śivalāla māṇikacaṃda koṭhārī, budha śrī gulābacaṃda jīvana gāṃdhī, dahivaḍī śrī jīvarāja khuśālacaṃda gāṃdhī, phalaṭaṇa śrī caṃdūlāla kastūracaṃda, muṃbaī
śrī padmarāja vaidya, nimagāṃva
śrī hirācaṃda talakacaṃda, bārāmatī
ācārya mahārājake saṃketa aura ājñānusāra saba granthoṃke lie kāgaja saṃsthākī ora se diyā gayā hai | granthoṃkā vitaraṇa pratyeka śahara tathā grāmameṃ jahāṃ para di. jaina bhāī aura di. jinamandira vidyamāna haiṃ, vahāṃ para pratyeka granthakī eka eka prati pahuṃce, aisī yojanā kī gaī hai | saṃsthāke sabhī sadasyoṃ ko bhī eka eka prati vinā mūlya dī jātī hai |
I
samāja ke jina śrīmānoṃkā saṃsthākī sthāpanā aura vikāsameṃ hameṃ ārthika sahayoga prāpta hai aura jisake kāraṇa saṃsthāke dvārā mahān kārya ho rahe haiṃ, tathā jo ācārya mahārājakī amūrta ājñāko sākāra evaṃ kāryānvita karanemeṃ pradhāna kāraṇa haiṃ aise una sabhī śrīmānoṃ aura udāratāpūrvaka granthoṃ kī chapāī ādimeṃ ārthika sahāyatā pahuṃcānevāle dātāroṃko unake dharma-premake lie hārdika dhanyavāda hai |
āśā hai ki samāja ke anya dānī dharma-premī mahānubhāva isa parama pavitra viśva-pāvanī jinavāṇīke prasārake mahattvapūrṇa kārya ke lie sakriya sahayoga dekara aura apanī udāratā prakaṭa kara mahān puṇyakā saṃcaya kareṃge, tāki saṃsthākā kārya uttarottara vṛddhiṃgata hotā rahe |

śrī. hirācaṃda talakacaṃda śāhakā paricaya
kamaleśvara gotrī śeṭha hirācanda talakacaṃda śahā ḍoralevāḍīkarake pūrvaja īṃḍara ( gujarāta ) jileke antargata bhilavaḍa़e grāma ke rahanevāle the | āpake prapitāmaha ( paḍa़dādā ) vyāpārake nimitta mahārāṣṭrameṃ āye | ve cāra bhāī the rakacaṃda, tārācaṃda, devacaṃda aura khemacaṃda | inameṃ se rakacaṃdake putra dalacaṃda hue | unake do putra hue- talakacaṃda aura maganalāla | inameṃse talakacaṃda ke tīna putra hue- hirācaṃda, māṇikacaṃda aura motīcaṃda | inameṃse hirācaṃda śahāne isa granthake chapānekā bhāra uṭhāyā hai | āpake cāra suputra haiṃ- candrakāṃta, sūryakāṃta, kiraṇa aura śreṇika | tathā do suputrī haiṃvimalā aura surekhā | inakī mātuśrīkā nāma ratanabāī hai | unakī āyu isa samaya 75 varṣakī hai| ve isa vṛddhāvasthā meṃ bhī dhārmika kāryake karane meṃ sadā tatpara rahatī haiṃ 1
seṭha hirācaṃda ke paḍa़dādā cāroṃ bhāiyoṃne phalaṭaṇake jinamandirameṃ ratnatraya prabhukā mandira nirmāṇa karāyā aura usakī nitya pūjana-arcanake lie 3000) kā dāna diyā |

ina tīnoṃ prakārake samyagdarśanoṃmeṃse upaśamasamyaktvakā jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭa kāla eka antarmuhūrta hī hai | kṣāyikasamyaktvakā jaghanya kāla antarmuhūrta hai aura utkṛṣṭa kāla saṃsāra-vāsakī apekṣā kucha kama do pūrva-koṭi varṣa se adhika tettīsa sāgara hai, tathā mokṣa - nivāsakī apekṣā anantakāla hai | vedaka samyaktvakā javanya kāla antarmuhūrta hai aura utkṛṣṭa kāla chayāsaṭha sāgara hai | kahanekā bhāva yaha hai ki koī jīva yadi aupaśamika samyagdarśanako prāpta kara cauthe guṇasthāna meṃ ātā hai to usakī apekṣā usakā kāla antarmuhūrta hī hai | aura yadi kṣāyika yā vedaka samyaktvake sātha cauthe guṇasthāna meṃ rahatā hai to ūpara ina donoṃkā jo utkṛṣṭa kāla batalāye haiṃ, utane kāla taka vaha jīva cauthe guṇasthāna meṃ banā rahatā hai |
5 deśasaṃyata guṇasthāna- samyagdarśanakī prāptike paścāt jaba jīvake apratyākhyānāvaraṇa krodha, māna, māyā aura lobha ina cāroṃ kaṣāyoṃkā kṣayopaśama hotā hai, taba jīvake bhāva śrāvaka vratadhāraṇa karane ke hote haiṃ aura vaha apanī śaktike anusāra śrāvakakī 11 pratimāoṃ ( kakṣāoṃ ) se yathā saṃbhava pratimāoṃke vratoṃko dhāraṇa karatā hai | isa guṇasthānavālā jīva bhītara se sakalasaṃyama arthāt sampūrṇa cāritra ko dhāraṇa karane ke bhāva rakhate hue bhī pratyākhyānāvaraṇa kaṣāyake tīvra udayase use dhāraṇa nahīṃ kara pātā hai, ataḥ yaha sthūla hiṃsā, jhūṭha, corī, kuśīla aura parigraharūpa paṃca pāpoṃkā yāvajjīvanake lie tyāga karatā hai | digvrata, deśavrata aura anarthadaṇḍavirata ina tīna guṇoṃ ko bhī dhāraṇa karatā hai | pratidina tīnoṃ saṃdhyāoṃ meṃ kamase kama do ghaḍī ( 48 miniṭa ) . kāla baiṭhakara sāmāyika karatā hai, arthāta prāṇimātra ke sātha samatābhāvakī upāsanā karatā huā iṣṭa-aniṣṭa padārthoṃmeṃ rāgadveṣakā parityāga karatā hai | pratyeka pakṣakī aṣṭamī aura caturdaśīko anna-jalakā aura vyāpārādi kāryokā parityāga karake upavāsa aṃgīkāra kara dina-rāta kā sārā samaya dharma sādhanameṃ vyatīta karatā hai| khāna-pāna aura dainika vyavahārakī vastuoṃmeṃse āvaśyakoṃ ko

1 adhaḥkaraṇa pariṇāma- jaba jīva cāritra mohanīyake upaśama yā kṣayake lie udyata hotā hai, taba antarmuhūrta kāla taka usake pariṇāma yadyapi uttarottara viśuddha hote rahate haiṃ, tathāpi usake pariṇāmoṃ kī yadi tulanā usake pīche adhaḥkaraṇa pariṇāmoṃko māṃḍanevāle jīvake sātha kī jāya to kadācit kisī jīvake pariṇāmoṃke sātha sadṛśatā pāī jā sakatī hai| isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki isa jātike pariṇāmoṃke asaṃkhya bheda haiṃ | pahilā jīva madhyama jātikī jisa viśuddhike sātha caḍha़tā huā tīsare yā cauthe samaya meṃ jisa jātikī viśuddhiko prāpta karatā hai, dūsarā jīva utanīhī triśuddhi ke sātha pahalehī samaya meṃ caḍha़ sakatā hai | ataḥ usa pahalevāle jīvake pariṇāma isa adhastana samayavartī jīvake pariṇāmoṃke sātha samānatā rakhate haiṃ, ataḥ unheṃ adhaḥkaraṇa pariṇāma kahate haiṃ |

9 anivṛttikaraṇaguṇasthāna- isa guṇarathānameṃ praveśa karanevāle jīvake pariṇāmabhī pratisamaya anantaguṇī viśuddhise baḍha़te rahate haiṃ aura yahāṃpara bhī apūrvakaraṇake samānahī ukta cāroṃ kārya hote haiṃ | isa prakāra isa guṇasthānake kālakā bahubhāga vyatīta honepara upaśama śreṇīpara caḍhā huā jīva apratyākhyānādi bāraha kaṣāya aura nava nokaṣāya ina ikkīsa moha-prakṛtiyoṃkā antarakaraṇa karatā hai | ina prakṛtiyoṃkī vivakṣita sthalase nīce aura ūparakī kitanīhī sthitiyoṃko choḍa़kara antarmuhūrtapramāṇa madhyavartī sthitiyoṃke niṣekoṃke dravyako ūpara aura nīcekī sthitiyoṃke dravyameṃ nikṣepaṇa karake vahāṃke niṣekoṃke abhāva karaneko antarakaraṇa kahate haiṃ | antarakaraṇake paścāt upaśāmaka jīva sarvaprathama napuṃsakavedakā upaśama karatā hai, tadanantara strīvedakā aura usake paścāt hāsyādi chaha nokaṣāyoṃkā aura puruṣavedakā upaśama karatā hai | tatpaścāt apratyākhyānāvaraṇacatuṣka
aura pratyākhyānāvaraṇacatuṣka ina āṭhoṃ madhyama kaṣāyoṃkā upaśama karatā hai | isake anantara kramase saṃjvalana, krodha, māna, māyā aura bādara lobhakā upaśama karake navave guṇasthānake kālako samāpta karatā hai| kintu jo jīva kṣapakaśreṇīpara caḍha़kara isa guṇarathānameṃ āyā hai, vaha navave guṇasthānake bahubhāga vyatīta honepara sarvaprathama 1 styānagṛddhi, 2 nidrānidrā, 3 pracalāpracalā, 4 narakagati, 5 narakagatyānupūrvī, 6 tiryaggati, 7 tiryaggatyānupūrvī, 8 ekendriyajāti, 9 dvīndriyajāti 10 trīndriyajāti, 11 caturindriyajāti, 12 ātapa, 13 udyota, 14 sthāvara, 15 sūkṣma, aura 16 sādhāraṇa ina solaha prakṛtiyoṃkā kṣaya karatā hai| tadanantara āṭha madhyama kaṣāyoṃkā kṣaya karatā hai| tadanantara cāra saṃjvalana aura nava nokaṣāyoṃkā antara karake sarvaprathama napuṃsakavedakā kṣaya karatā hai, punaḥ strīvedakā kṣaya karatā hai aura tatpaścāt chaha nokaṣāyoṃkā aura puruṣavedakā kṣaya karatā hai| isake paścāt kramase saṃjvalana krodha, māna, māyā aura bādara lobhakā kṣaya karake . navaveṃ guṇasthānakā kāla samāpta karatā hai|

5 vedamārgaṇā- cāritramohanīyakarmakā bheda jo veda nokaṣāyavedanīya hai, usake udayase strī, puruṣa yā ubhayake viṣaya sevanarūpa bhāvoṃko veda kahate haiṃ| vedake tīna bheda haiṃ-- strīveda, puruṣaveda aura napuṃsakaveda | striyoṃko puruṣoṃke sātha ramanekī jo icchā hotī hai, use strīveda kahate haiṃ| puruṣoṃko striyoṃke sātha ramanekī abhilāṣāko puruṣaveda kahate haiṃ | srī aura puruṣa donoṃke sātha ramanekī abhilāṣāko napuṃsakaveda kahate haiṃ | athavā ukta donoṃ vedoṃkī abhilāṣārūpa pravṛttise bhinna jisa kisībhī prāṇī yā usake aṃga-upāṃgoṃke sātha ramaneke bhāvako napuṃsakaveda kahate haiṃ | ekendriyoṃse lekara asaṃjñīpaṃceṃndriyoṃ takake sarva jīva napuṃsakavedīhī hote haiṃ | saṃjñīpaṃcendriyoṃmeṃ tīnoṃvedī jīva hote haiṃ| unameṃ bhī nārakiyoṃke kevala napuṃsakaveda hotā hai aura devoṃke strī vā puruṣa ye do veda hote haiṃ| manuṣya aura saṃjñīpaṃcendriyoṃmeṃ tīnoṃ vedavāle jīva pāye jāte haiṃ| guṇasthānoṃkī apekṣā ye tīnoṃ veda navaveṃ guṇasthānake saveda bhāga taka pāye jāte haiṃ, usase ūparake śeṣa guṇasthāna vartī manuṣya aura siddhoṃko avedī jānanā cāhie |
6 kaṣāyamārgaṇā- jo sukha-duḥkhako utpanna karanevāle karmarūpī kṣetrakā karṣaṇa kare, ātmāke samyagdarśana, saṃyamāsaṃyama, sakalasaṃyama aura yathākhyātacāritrako na hone de, use kaṣāya kahate haiṃ| kaṣāyake cāra bheda haiṃ- krodha, māna, māyā aura lobha | saṃsārake kṣudrase kṣudra ekendriya prāṇīse lekara cāroṃ gatiyoṃke paṃcendriya prāṇiyoṃtaka sabhīke ye cāroṃ kaṣāya pāī jātī hai| yahāṃ taka ki ātma-vikāsa karanevāle jīvoṃke bhī navaveṃ guṇasthāna taka cāroṃ kaṣāya pāī jātī haiṃ | navaveṃ guṇasthānameṃ krodha, māna, māyā kaṣāyakā kṣaya hotā hai | lobhakaṣāya daśaveṃ guṇa sthānataka pāyā jātā hai, usake antameṃ hī lobha kaṣāyakā kṣaya hotā hai| isake ūpara kaṣāyoṃkā abhāva honese gyārahaveṃ ādi cāra guṇasthānavī jīvoṃko aura siddhoṃko akaṣāya arthāt kaṣāya-rahita

7 jñānamāgeṇā- jisake dvārā vastu-svarūpa jānā jātā hai, use jñāna kahate haiṃ | jñānake pāṃca bheda haiṃ- ābhinibodhika jñāna ( matijñāna ), śrutajñāna, avadhijñāna, manaḥparyayajñāna aura kevalajñāna | abhimukha sthita niyamita vastukā indriya aura manakī sahāyatāse jo jñāna utpanna hotā hai, use ābhinibodhikajñāna kahate haiṃ| ābhinibodhikajñānase jānī huī vastukā āśraya lekara usase sambaddha kintu bhinna hī padārthake jānaneko śrutajñāna kahate hai| jaise kisī sthānase nikalate hue dhūmako dekha kara rasoīghara ādimeṃ sthita agnikā jñāna karanā aura dhūma śabdako sunakara usake kāraṇabhūta agnikā jñāna honā | dravya, kṣetra, kāla, bhāvakī apekṣā lekara indriyoṃkī sahāyatāke vināhī rūpī padārthoṃke sākṣāt jānaneko avadhijñāna kahate haiṃ| bhūtakālameṃ manake dvārā vicārī gaī, vartamānameṃ manaḥsthita aura āgāmī kālameṃ manake dvārā socī jānevālī bāta jānaleneko manaḥparyayajñāna kahate hai| triloka aura trikālavartī samasta dravyoṃko tathā traikālika anantaguṇa aura paryāyoṃke sākṣāt yugapat jānanevāle jñānako kevalajñāna kahate haiṃ| inamese prārambhake tīna jñāna mithyārūpabhī hote haiṃ, jinhe kramaśaḥ mati-ajñāna, śrutājñāna aura vibhaṃgājñāna kahate haiṃ| samyagdarśana honeke pūrvataka prārambhake tīna guṇasthānoṃmeṃ saṃsārījīvoṃke jo mati, śruta, avadhijñāna hote haiṃ, unheṃ mithyājñānahī jānanā cāhie| cauthe guṇasthānase lekara ūparake guṇasthānoṃmeṃ jo jñāna hote haiṃ, ve saba samyagjñānahī hote haiṃ| manaḥparyayajñāna chaṭhe guṇasthānase lekara bārahaveṃ guṇasthāna taka hotā hai | kevalajñāna terahaveṃ, caudahaveṃ guṇasthānoṃmeṃ aura siddhoṃke hotā hai |
8 saṃyamamārgaṇā- paṃca mahāvratoṃke dhāraṇa karanā, paṃca samitiyoṃkā pālana karanā, krodhādi kaṣāyoṃkā nigraha karanā, mana-vacana-kāyarūpa tīna daṇḍoṃkā tyāga karanā aura pāṃca indriyoṃke viṣayoṃkā jītanā saṃyama hai| saṃyamake pāṃca bheda haiṃ- sāmāyika, chedopasthāpanā, parihāraviśuddhi, sūkṣmasāmparāya, yathākhyāta | inake atirikta deśasaṃyama aura asaṃyamabhī isī mārgaṇāke antargata āte haiṃ| sarva sāvadyayogake tyāgakara abhedarūpa eka saṃyamako dhāraṇa karanā sāmāyikasaṃyama hai | usī abhedarūpa eka saṃyamako do, tīna, cāra, pāṃca mahāvratoṃke bhedarūpase dhāraṇa karanā chedopasthāpanā saṃyama hai| tīsa varṣataka gṛhasthāśramameṃ rahakara aura apanī icchānusāra sarva prakārake bhogoṃko acchī tarahase bhogakara tadanantara munidīkṣā lekarake jo tīrthaṃkarake pādamūlameṃ varṣapṛthakatva (tīnase ūpara aura nau varṣase nīcekī saṃkhyāko pṛthakatva kahate haiṃ ) kālataka rahakara pratyākhyānapūrvakā bhalībhāṃti adhyayana karanā isa prakārakī sādhanāko prāpta karatā hai ki usake gamanāgamana, āhāra-vihāra aura śayanāsana ādi kriyāoṃko karate hue kisībhī prakāra jīvako raṃcamātra bhī bādhā nahīṃ hotī hai| isa prakārakī sādhanāviśeṣake sātha jo saṃyamakā abhedarūpase yā bhedarūpase pālana hotā hai, use parihāraviśuddhi saṃyama kahate haiṃ| jinakī samasta kaṣāyeṃ naṣṭa ho

13 saṃjñimārgaṇā- noindriya- ( mana-) āvaraṇa karmake kṣayopaśamako yā tajjanita jñānako saṃjñā kahate haiṃ| isa prakārakī saṃjñā jinake pāī jātī hai, aise śikṣā, kriyā, ālāpa ( śabda ) aura upadeśako grahaṇa karanevāle mana-sahita jīvoṃko saṃjñī kahate haiṃ | jinake isa prakārakī saṃjñā nahīṃ pāī jātī hai, aise mana-rahita jīvoṃko asaṃjñī kahate haiṃ| ekendriyase lekara caturindriya takake samasta jīva asaṃjñīhī haiṃ| paṃcendriyoṃmeṃ deva, manuṣya aura narakagatike samasta jīva saṃjñīhī hote haiṃ| tiryaṃca paṃcendriyoṃ meṃ kucha jalacara, thalacara aura nabhacara jīva aise hote haiṃ, jinake mana nahīṃ hotā, unheṃ bhī asaṃjñī jānanā cāhie | asaṃjñī jīvoṃke kevala eka mithyātva guṇasthāna hī hotā hai| saṃjñī jīvoṃke pahilese lekara bārahaveṃ takake bāraha guṇasthāna hotā hai| sayogikevalī, ayogikevalī aura siddha bhagavān ko saṃjñī-asaṃjñīke nāmase atīta yā paravartī jānanā cāhie | isa prakāra saṃjñā aura asaṃjñāke dvārā jīvoṃke anveṣaṇa karaneko saṃjñīmārgaṇā kahate haiṃ|
14 āhāramārgaṇā- audārikādi tīna śarīra aura chaha paryāptiyoṃke yogya nokarmavargaṇāoṃke grahaṇa karaneko āhāra kahate haiṃ| isa prakārake āhāra grahaṇa karanevāle jīvoṃko āhāraka kahate haiṃ aura jo isa prakārake āhārako grahaṇa nahīṃ karate haiṃ, unheṃ anāhāraka kahate haiṃ| jaba jīva eka śarīrako choḍa़kara anya śarīrako grahaṇa karaneke lie dūsarī gatimeṃ jātā hai, taba bīcameṃ yadi vigraha ( moḍa़ ) lekara janma lenā paḍa़e to usake anāhāraka daśā rahegī| isa. vigraha gatimeṃ eka moḍa़ lenepara eka samaya, do moḍa़ lenepara do samaya aura tīna moḍa़ lenepara tīna samayataka jīva anāhāraka rahatā hai| tadanantara vaha niyamase āhāraka ho jātā hai| kevalī bhagavān jaba kevali samuddhāta karate haiṃ, taba caḍha़te aura utarate pratara samuddhātameṃ tathā lokapūraṇa samuddhātameṃ isa prakāra tīna samayataka ve bhī anāhāraka rahate haiṃ| ina ukta prakārake jīvoṃko choḍa़kara śeṣa saba saṃsārī jīvoṃko āhāraka jānanā cāhie| ayogikevalī aura siddha jīvabhī anāhāraka hī haiṃ | vigrahagatikī anāhāraka daśā pahile, dūsare aura cauthe guṇasthānameṃ hotī hai | kevalī bhagavānke kevalisamuddhāta terahaveṃ guṇasthānake antameṃ hotā hai | isa prakāra āhāraka-anāhārakake rūpase trailokyake sarva jīvoṃke mārgaṇa karaneko āhāramārgaṇā kahate haiṃ |
1 satprarūpaṇākā viṣaya satprarūpaṇā- sat nāma astitvakā hai| tīna lokameṃ jīvoṃkā astitva kahāṃ kahāṃ hai | aura kisa prakārase hai ? isa praśnakā uttara denāhī satprarūpaṇākā viṣaya hai| ukta praśnakā uttara satprarūpaṇāmeṃ do prakāra se diyā gayā hai- oghase aura ādeśase | ogha nāma sāmānya, saṃkṣepa yā guṇasthānakā hai aura ādeśa nāma vistāra, viśeṣa yā mārgaṇā sthānakā hai | ukta praśnakā

2 saṃkhyāprarūpaṇā athavā dravyapramāṇānugama
dūsare anuyogadvārakā nāma saṃkhyāprarūpaṇā yā dravyapramāṇānugama hai | samasta jīvarāśi kitanī hai aura kisa kisa guṇasthāna, tathā mārgaṇāsthānameṃ jīvoṃkā pramāṇa kitanā kitanā hai, yaha bāta isa anuyogadvāra meṃ batalāī gaī hai | jīvoṃkā pramāṇa dravya, kṣetra, kāla aura bhāvakī apekṣā cāra prakāra se batalāyā gayā hai | isa saṃkhyāprarūpaṇākā svādhyāya karanevāloṃko dravya-kṣetrādi pramāṇoṃkā svarūpa jāna lenā atyāvaśyaka hai, anyathā isa prarūpaṇa meṃ varṇita viṣaya samajhameṃ nahīṃ ā sakatā | ataḥ yahāṃ saṃkṣepase unakā varṇana kiyā jātā hai |

samayoṃmeṃ honevāle kalaśa, darpaṇa, hala, mūsala, ratha, gāḍa़ī chatra, camara, siṃhāsana, dhanuṣa, bāṇa ādi kāmameṃ ānevālī vastuoṃkā, tathā tātkālika manuṣyoṃke rahaneke makāna, udyāna, nagara prāmādikā māpa ātmāṃgulase kiyā jātā hai| chaha aṃguloṃkā eka pāda, do pādoṃkī eka vihasti ( vilasta yā vethiyā ), do vihastiyokā eka hasta (hāta), do hāthoṃkā eka kiṣku, do kiṣkuoṃkā eka daṃḍa, yuga, dhanuṣa, nālī yā mūsala hotā hai| do hajāra dhanuṣoṃkā eka kośa aura cāra kośakā eka yojana hotā hai |
addhāpalyakā pramāṇa ūpara batalā āye haiṃ, usa addhāpalyake ardhaccheda'pramāṇa addhāpalyoṃkā paraspara guṇā karanepara sūcyaṃgulakā pramāṇa ātā hai | sūcyaṃgulake vargako pratarāṃgula aura ghanako ghanāṃgula kahate haiṃ | addhāpalyakeṃ asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa', athavā matāntarase addhāpatyake jitane ardhaccheda hoṃ, usake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa ghanāṃguloṃke paraspara guṇā karanepara jo pramāṇa ātā hai use jagacchreṇī kahate haiṃ | jagacchreṇīke sātaveṃ bhāgako rāju yā rajju kahate haiṃ | isa rājukā pramāṇa madhyalokake vistāra barābara hai | jagacchreṇīke vargako jagatpratara aura ghanako ghanaloka kahate haiṃ |

5 kālaprarūpaṇā
kisa guṇasthāna aura kisa mārgaṇāsthānameṃ jīva kamase kama kitane kāla taka rahate haiṃ aura adhikase adhika kāla taka rahate haiṃ, isakā vivecana, kālānugama nāmake anuyogadvārameṃ kiyā gayā hai| sūtrakārane kālakā yaha vivecana eka jīva aura nānā jīvoṃkī apekṣāse kiyā hai| yathāmithyādṛṣṭi jīva mithyātvaguṇasthānameṃ kitane kāla taka rahate haiṃ ? isa praśnakā uttara diyā gayā hai ki nānā jīvoṃkī apekṣā to mithyādṛṣṭi jīva mithyātva guṇasthānameṃ sadā hī rahate haiṃ, arthāt tīnoṃ kāloṃ meṃ aisā eka bhī samaya nahī hai, jaba ki mithyādṛṣṭi jīva na pāye jāte hoṃ| kintu eka jīvakī apekṣā mithyātvakā kāla tīna prakārakā hai- anādi-ananta, anādi-sānta aura sādi-sānta | abhavya jīvoṃke mithyātvakā kāla anādi-ananta jānanā cāhie| kyoṃki unake mithyātvakā na ādi hai aura na anta | jo anādi mithyādṛṣṭi bhavya jīva haiṃ, unake mithyātvakā kāla anādi-sānta hai; arthāt anādi kālase āja taka samyaktvakī prāpti na honese unakā mithyātva anādi hai, kintu āge jākara samyaktvakī prāpti aura mithyātvakā anta honese unakā mithyātva sānta hai| jina jīvoṃne eka bāra samyaktvako prāpta kara liyā, tathāpi pariṇāmoṃke saṃkleśādi nimittase jo phira bhī mithyātvako prāpta ho jāte haiṃ, unake mithyātvakā kāla sādi-sānta jānanā cāhie| sūtrakārane ina tīnoṃ prakārake mithyātva-kāloṃkā nirdeśa karake eka jīvakī apekṣā mithyātvakā jaghanya sādi-sānta kāla antarmuhūrta batalāyā hai, jisakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki yadi koī asaṃyata samyagdṛṣṭi, saṃyatāsaṃyata, yā pramattasaṃyata jīva pariṇāmoṃke patanase mithyātvako prāpta ho aura mithyātva daśāmeṃ sabase choṭe antarmuhūrta kāla rahakara punaḥ asaṃyata samyagdṛṣṭi, yā saṃyatāsaṃyata, yā apramattasaṃyata ho jāya; to aise jīvake mithyātvakā jaghanya kāla antarmuhūrta pramāṇa pāyā jātā hai| isa prakārake mithyātvako sādi-sānta kahate haiṃ; kyoṃki usakā ādi aura anta donoṃ pāye jāte haiṃ| isī sādi-sānta mithyātvakā utkṛṣṭa kāla kucha kama 'ardhapudgalaparivartanapramāṇa hai| isakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki jaba koī jīva pahilī vāra samyaktva prāpta kara atiśīghra mithyātvako prāpta ho jātā hai, to vaha adhikase adhika bhī mithyātva guṇasthāna meṃ rahegā, to kucha kama ardhapudgalaparivartana meṃ jitanā kāla lagatā hai, kucha kama utane kāla taka hī rahegā, usake anantara yaha niyamase samyaktvako prāpta kara aura saṃyamako dhāraṇa kara mokṣa calā jātā hai |

6 antara prarūpaṇā antara nāma viraha, vyuccheda yā abhāvakā hai| kisī vivakṣita guṇasthānavī jīvakā usa guṇasthānako choḍa़ kara anya guṇasthānameṃ cale jāne para punaḥ usī guṇasthānakī prāptike pūrva : .. takake kālakā antarakāla yā virahakāla kahate haiṃ| sabase choṭe virahakālako jaghanya antara aura sabase baḍa़e viraha kālako utkṛṣṭa antara kahate haiṃ| isa prakārake antarakālakā prarūpaṇā karanevālī isa antara prarūpaṇā meṃ yaha batalāyā gayā hai ki yaha jīva kisa guṇasthāna aura mārgaṇāsthānase kamase kama kitane kāla takake lie aura adhikase adhika kitane kāla takake lie antarako prāpta hotā hai|
jaise- oghakī apekṣā kisīne pūchā ki mithyādṛṣṭijīvoṃkā antarakāla kitanā hai ? isakā uttara diyā gayā hai ki nānā jīvoṃkī apekṣā antara nahīṃ hai, ve nirantara haiṃ| arthāt saṃsārameṃ sadā hī mithyādṛṣṭi jīva pāye jāte haiṃ, ataḥ unakā antarakāla sambhava nahīṃ hai| kintu eka jīvakī apekṣā mithyātvakā jaghanya antara kāla antarmuhūrtapramāṇa hai| yaha jaghanya antarakāla isa prakāra ghaṭita hotā hai ki koī eka mithyādṛṣṭi jīva pariṇāmoṃkī viśuddhike nimittase samyaktva ko prāpta kara asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi ho gayā| vaha isa cauthe guṇasthānameṃ sabase choṭe antarmuhūrta kāla taka samyaktvake sātha rahakara saṃkleśa ādike nimittase girā aura mithyādṛṣṭi ho gayā| isa prakāra mithyātvaguṇasthānako choḍa़kara aura anya guṇasthānako prāpta hokara punaḥ usī guṇasthānameṃ āneke pūrva taka jo antarmuhūrttakāla mithyātvaparyāyase rahita rahā, yahī usa eka jīvakī apekṣā mithyādṛṣṭiguṇasthānakā jaghanya antarakāla hai |
mithyātvakā utkṛṣṭa antarakāla eka jīvakī apekṣā kucha kama do chyāsaṭa sāgara arthāt eka sau battīsa ( 132 ) sāgaropama hai| yaha utkṛṣṭa antarakāla isa prakāra ghaṭita hotā hai ki koī jīva caudaha sāgarakī āyuvāle lāntava-kāpiṣṭha svargake devoṃmeṃ utpanna huā| vahāṃ eka sāgarake paścāt samyaktvako prāpta kiyā | punaḥ teraha sāgarataka vahāṃ rahakara samyaktvake sātha hī cyuta ho manuṣya ho gayā| yahāṃpara saṃyamāsaṃyama yā saṃyamako dhāraṇa kara marā aura bāīsa sāgarakī āyuvāle solahaveṃ svargameṃ deva utpanna ho gayā| vahāṃ apanī pūrī āyuparyaṃta samyaktvake sātha rahakara cyuta ho punaḥ manuṣya ho gayā| isa bhavameṃ saṃyamako dhāraṇa kara marā aura ikatīsa sāgarakī āyuvāle nauṃveṃ graiveyakameṃ jākara utpanna ho gayā| vahāṃpara jīvana paryanta samyagdṛṣṭi rahā, kintu jīvanake anta meṃ chayāsaṭha sāgara pūre ho jānepara miśra prakṛtikā udaya ā jānese tīsare guṇasthānako prāpta

ukta bhāvoṃmeṃse kisa guṇasthāna aura kisa mārgaṇāsthāna meṃ kaunasā bhāva hotā hai, isakā vivecana isa bhāva prarūpaṇāmeṃ kiyā gayā hai| jaise oghakī apekṣā pūchā gayā ki 'mithyādṛṣṭi ' yaha kaunasā bhāva hai ? isakā uttara diyā gayā ki mithyādṛṣṭi yaha audayika bhāva hai| isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki jīvoṃke mithyādṛṣṭi arthāt viparīta śraddhā mithyātvakarmake udayase hotī hai| yahāṃ yaha śaṃkā kī jā sakatī hai ki jaba mithyādṛṣṭi jīvake mithyātva bhāva ke atirikta jñāna, darśana, bhavyatva ādi anya bhī bhāva pāye jāte hai, taba usake eka mātra audayika bhāva hī kyoṃ batalāyā gayā? isakā uttara yaha diyā gayā hai ki yadyapi mithyādṛṣṭi jīvake audayika bhāvake atirikta anya bhāva bhī hote haiṃ, kintu ve mithyādṛṣṭitvake kāraṇa nahīṃ hai, eka mātra mithyātvakarmakā udaya hī mithyādṛṣṭitvakā kāraṇa hotā hai, isalie mithyātva guṇasthānameṃ paidā honevāle mithyādṛṣṭiko audayika bhāva kahā gayā hai|
dūsare guṇasthānameṃ anya bhāvoṃke rahate hue bhī pāriṇāmika batalānekā kāraṇa yaha hai ki jisa prakāra jīvatva ādi pāriṇāmika bhāvoṃke lie karmoṃkā udaya upaśama ādi kāraṇa nahīṃ hai usī prakāra sāsādana samyaktvarūpa bhāvake lie darśanamohanīyakarmakā udaya, upaśamādi koī bhī kāraṇa nahīṃ hai, isalie yahāṃ pāriṇāmika bhāva hī jānanā cāhie |
tīsare guṇasthānameṃ kṣāyopaśamika bhāva hotā hai| yahāṃ yaha śaṃkā uṭhāī jā sakatī hai ki pratibandhī karmake udaya honepara bhī jo jīvake svābhāvika guṇakā aṃśa pāyā jātā hai vaha kṣāyopaśamika kahalātā hai| kintu samyagmithyātvaprakṛtike udayameṃ to samyaktvaguṇakī kaṇikā bhī avaśiṣṭa nahīṃ rahatī hai| yadi aisā na mānā jāya to samyagmithyātvaprakṛtike sarvaghātipanā nahīṃ bana sakatā| ataeva samyagmithyātva bhāvako kṣāyopaśamika mānanā ṭhīka nahīṃ hai| isakā uttara yaha hai ki samyagmithyātvaprakṛtike udaya honepara śraddhāna aura aśraddhānarūpa eka miśrabhāva utpanna hotā hai | usameṃ jo śraddhānāṃśa hai, vaha samyaktvaguṇakā aṃśa hai, use samyagmithyātvaprakṛtikā udaya naṣṭa nahīṃ karatā | ataḥ samyagmithyātva bhāvako kṣāyopaśamika hī mānanā cāhie | .... cauthe guṇasthānameṃ aupaśamika, kṣāyika aura kṣāyopaśamika ye tīna bhāva pāye jāte haiṃ| isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki yahāṃpara darśana mohanīya karmakā upaśama, kṣaya aura kṣayopaśama ye tīnoṃ hī hote haiṃ|
ādike ye cāra guṇasthāna darśanamohanīya karmake udaya, upaśama, kṣaya ādise utpanna hote haiṃ, isalie una guṇasthānoṃmeṃ anya bhāvoṃke pāye jāneparabhī darśanamohanīyakī apekṣāse bhāvoṃkī prarūpaṇā kī gaī hai| cauthe guṇasthānataka jo asaṃyamabhāva pāyā jātā hai, vaha cāritra mohanīya karmake udayase utpanna honeke kāraṇa audayika bhāva hai, para yahāṃ usakī vivakṣā nahīṃ kī gaī hai|

isa prarūpaṇāmeṃ saṃkhyāprarūpaṇāke ādhārapara guṇasthānoṃ aura mārgaṇāsthānoṃ meṃ pāye jānevāle jīvoṃ kī saṃkhyākṛta alpatā aura adhikatākā pratipādana kiyā gayā hai | guṇasthānoṃ meṃ jīvoṃkā aba isa prakāra batalāyā gayā hai- apūrvakaraṇa ādi tīna guṇasthānoṃmeṃ upaśāmaka jīva praveśakī apekṣā paraspara samāna haiṃ aura śeṣa saba guṇasthānoṃke pramāṇase alpa haiṃ, kyoṃ ki ina tīnoṃ hī guṇasthānoṃmeṃ pṛthak pṛthak rūpase praveśa karanevāle jīva eka, do, tīna ko ādi lekara adhika se adhika caupana taka hī pāye jāte haiṃ | itane kama jīva ina tīnoṃ upaśāmaka guṇasthānoṃko choḍa़kara anya kisī guṇasthānameṃ nahīṃ pāye jāte haiṃ | upaśāntakaṣāyavītarāgachadmastha jīva bhī pūrvokta pramāṇa hī haiṃ, kyoṃki ukta upaśāmaka jīva hī caḍha़te hue gyārahaveṃ guṇasthāna meṃ praveśa karate haiṃ | upaśāntakaṣāyavītarāgachadmasthoṃse apūrvakaraṇādi tīna guṇasthānavartī kṣapaka saṃkhyātaguṇita haiṃ, kyoṃki upaśāmaka ke eka guṇasthānameṃ adhikatama praveśa karanevāle caupana jīvoṃkī apekṣā kṣapakake eka guṇasthānameṃ adhikatama praveśa karanevāle eka sau āṭha jīvoṃke dūne pramāṇasvarūpa saṃkhyātaguṇitatā pāī jātī hai | kṣīṇakaṣāyavītarāgachadmastha jīva pūrvokta pramāṇa hī haiṃ, kyoṃki ukta kṣapaka jīva hī isa bārahaveṃ guṇasthāna meṃ praveśa karate haiṃ | sayogikevalī aura ayogikevalī jina praveśakī apekṣā donoṃ hī paraspara samāna hokara pūrvoktapramāṇa arthāt eka sau āṭha hī haiṃ | kintu sayogikevalī jina saṃcayakālakī apekṣā praveśa karanevāle jīvoṃse saṃkhyātaguṇita haiṃ | sayogikevalī jinoṃse sātaveṃ guṇasthānavāle apramattasaṃyata jīva saṃkhyātaguṇita haiṃ | apramattasaṃyatoṃse pramattasaṃyata jīva saṃkhyātaguṇita haiṃ pramattasaṃyatoṃse saṃyatāsaṃyata jīva asaṃkhyātaguṇita haiṃ; kyoṃki inameṃ manuṣya saṃyatāsaṃyatoṃ ke sātha tiryaṃca saṃyatāsaṃyata rāśi sammilita hai | saṃyatāsaṃyatoṃ se sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva asaṃkhyātaguṇita haiṃ | sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭiyoṃ se samyagmithyādṛṣṭi jīva

2 khuddābandha ( kṣudrabandha )
ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake isa dūsare khaṇḍa meṃ karma-bandhaka ke rūpameṃ jīvakī prarūpaṇā jina gyāraha anuyogadvāroṃke dvārā kī gaī hai, unake nāma isa prakāra haiṃ- 1 eka jīvakī apekṣā svāmitva, 2 eka jīvakī apekṣā kāla, 3 eka jīvakī apekṣā antara, 4 nānā jīvoṃkī apekṣā bhaṃgavicaya, 5 dravyapramāṇānugama, 6 kṣetrānugama, 7 sparśanānugama, 8 nānā jīvoṃkī apekṣā kāla, 9 nānā jīvoṃ kī apekṣā antara, 10 bhāgābhāgānugama aura 11 alpabahutvānugama | ina anuyogadvāroṃke prārambhameṃ bhūmikāke rūpameṃ bandhakoṃke sattvakī prarūpaṇā kī gaī hai aura antameṃ sabhī anuyogadvāroṃkī cūlikārūpase alpabahutva - mahādaṇḍaka diyā gayā 1

1 bandha
bandhana anuyogadvārake cāra bhedoṃmeṃ pahalā bheda bandha hai| nikṣepakī dṛṣṭise isake cāra bheda haiṃ- nāmabandha, sthāpanābandha, dravyabandha aura bhāvabandha | jīva, ajīva ādi jisa kisī bhī padārthakā 'bandha' aisā nāma rakhanā nāmabandha hai| tadākāra aura atadākāra padārthoṃ meṃ 'yaha bandha hai' aisī sthāpanā karanā sthāpanābandha hai| dravyabandhake do bheda haiṃ- āgamadravyabandha aura noāgamadravyabandha | bandhaviṣayaka sthita, jita ādi nau prakārake āgamameṃ vācanā ādirūpa jo anupayukta bhāva hotā hai, use āgamadravyabandha kahate haiṃ| no āgamadravyabandha do prakārakā hai-- prayogabandha
aura visrasābandha | visrasābandhake do bheda haiṃ- sādivisrasābandha aura anādivisrasābandha | dharmāstikāya ādi tīna dravyoṃkā apane apane deśoṃ aura pradeśoṃke sātha jo anādikālīna bandha hai, vaha anādi visrasābandha kahalātā hai | snigdha aura rūkṣaguṇayukta pudgaloṃkā jo bandha hotā hai, vaha sādivisrasābandha kahalātā hai| sādivisrasābandhakī viśeṣa jānakārīke lie mūla granthakā viśeṣarūpase svādhyāya karanā apekṣita hai| nānā prakārake skandha isī sādivisrasābandhake kāraṇa banate haiṃ| prayogabandha do prakārakā hai- karmabandha aura nokarmabandha | nokarmabandhake pāṃca bheda haiṃālāpanabandha, allīpanabandha, saṃśleṣabandha, śarīrabandha aura śarīribandha | kāṣṭha ādi pṛthagbhūta dravyoṃko rassī ādise bāṃdhanā ālāpanabandha hai | lepaviśeṣake kāraṇa vividha dravyoṃke pārasparika bandhako allīpanabandha kahate haiṃ | lākha, goṃda ādise do padārthoṃkā paraspara cipakanā saṃśleṣabandha hai| pāṃca śarīroṃkā yathāyogya bandhako prāpta honā śarīra bandha hai| śarīri bandhake do bheda haiṃ- sādiśarīri bandha aura anādi śarīribandha | jīvakā audārika ādi śarīroṃke sātha jo bandha hai, vaha sādiśarīri bandha hai | jīvake āṭha madhyapradeśoṃkā paraspara jo bandha hai, vaha anādi śarīribandha hai | isī prakāra śarīradhārī prāṇīkā anādikālase jo karma aura nokarmake sātha bandha ho rahā hai, use bhī anādi śarīribandha samajhanā cāhie|

chakkhaṃḍāgama
__ bhāvabandhake do bheda haiṃ- āgamabhāvabandha aura noāgamabhāvabandha | bandhaśāstraviṣaya sthita, jita ādi nau prakārake āgamameṃ vācanā, pṛcchanā ādirūpa jo upayukta bhāva hotā hai, use āgamabhāvabandha kahate haiṃ| no āgamabhāvabandha do prakārakā hai- jīvabhāvabandha aura ajīvabhāvabandha | jīvabhāvabandhake tīna bheda haiṃ- vipākaja jīvabhāvabandha, avipākaja jīvabhāvabandha aura tadubhayarūpa jīvabhāvabandha | jīvavipākī apane apane karmake udayase devabhāva, manuṣyabhāva, tiryagbhāva, nārakabhāva, strīvedabhāva, puruṣavedabhāva, krodhabhāva ādirūpa jo bhāva utpanna hote haiṃ, ve saba vipākaja jīvabhāvabandha haiṃ | avipākaja jīvabhāvabandhake do bheda haiṃ- aupaśamika aura kṣāyika | upaśānta krodha, upaśānta māna ādi bhāva aupaśamika avipākaja jīvabhāvabandha kahalāte haiṃ| kṣīṇamoha, kṣīṇamāna ādi kṣāyika avipākaja jīvabhāvabandha kahalāte haiṃ | ekendriyalabdhi ādi kṣāyopaśamikabhāva tadubhayarūpa jīvabhāvabandha kahalāte haiṃ| ajīvabhāvabandha bhī vipākaja, avipākaja aura tadubhayake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| pudgalavipākī karmoke udayase śarīrameṃ jo varṇādi utpanna hote haiṃ, ve vipākaja ajīvabhāvabandha kahalāte haiṃ| pudgalake vividha skandhoṃmeṃ jo khābhāvika varṇādi hote haiṃ, ve avipākaja ajīvabhāvabandha kahalāte haiṃ| donoṃ prakārake mile hue varṇādika tadubhayarūpa ajīvabhāvabandha kahalāte haiṃ|
bandhake uparyukta bhedoṃmeṃse yahāṃpara noāgamadravyabandhake karma aura nokarmabandhase prayojana hai|
2 bandhaka karmake bandha karanevāle jīvako bandhaka kahate haiṃ| bandhaka jīvoṃkī prarūpaṇā ā0 bhūtabaline khuddābandha nāmake dūsare khaṇḍameṃ vistārase kī gaī hai, vaha saba isī anuyogadvārake antargata jānanā cāhie|
3 bandhanīya ___ jīvase pṛthagbhūta kintu bandhaneke yogya jo paudgalika karma - nokarmaskandha haiṃ, unakī 'bandhanīya ' saṃjñā hai| ye baṃdhe hue karma -- nokarmarūpa pudgalaskandha dravya, kṣetra, kāla aura bhāvake anusāra vedanayogya hote haiṃ| sabhī pudgalaskandha vedanayogya nahīṃ hote; kintu teīsa prakārakī pudgalavargaṇāoṃmeṃ jo grahaṇaprāyogya vargaṇāeṃ haiṃ, ve jaba ātmāke yoga-dvārā ākṛṣṭa hokara karma aura nokarmarūpase pariṇata hokara ātmāke sātha bandhako prāpta hotī haiṃ, tabhī vedanayogya hotī hai|
ā0 bhūtabaline isa ‘bandhanīya ' kā aneka anuyogadvāroṃ aura unake avāntara adhikāroṃ dvārā vistārase varṇana kiyā hai, jisakā anubhava to pāṭhaka mūlagranthakā svādhyāya karake hī kara sakeṃge | yahāṃ vargaṇāsambandhī kucha khāsa jānakārī dī jātī hai |

utkṛṣṭa agrahaṇadravyavargaṇāke ūpara eka paramāṇu ke milānepara jaghanya taijasadravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | punaḥ eka eka adhika paramāṇuke baḍha़āte hue abhavyoṃse anantaguṇita aura siddhoṃke anantaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa sthāna āge jānepara utkṛṣṭa taijasadravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | isa taijasadravyavargaṇāse taijasaśarīrakā nirmāṇa hotā hai | yaha sātavīṃ vargaṇā hai |
taijasadravyavaṇāke ūpara eka paramāṇu milānepara dūsarī jaghanya agrahaṇadravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | punaḥ pūrvokta kramase eka eka paramāṇuke baḍha़āte hue anantasthāna āge jānepara utkṛṣṭa agrahaṇadravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | ye sabhī agrahaṇavargaṇāeṃ bhī jīvake dvārā agrāhya hone se śarīrādi . kisī kārya meṃ nahīṃ ātī haiṃ | yaha āṭhavīṃ vargaṇā hai |
ukta utkṛṣṭa agrahaṇadravyavargaṇā ke ūpara eka paramāṇukī vṛddhi honepara jaghanya bhāṣādravyavargaṇa prāpta hotī hai | punaḥ pūrvokta kramase eka eka paramāṇuke baḍha़āte hue anantasthāna āge jānepara utkṛṣṭa bhāṣādravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | isa bhāṣāvargaṇā ke paramāṇu hī vividha prakārakī bhāṣāoṃke rūpameṃ śabda rūpase pariṇata hokara bole jāte haiṃ | yaha navavīṃ vargaṇā hai |

[ 73 utkṛṣṭa kārmaṇa dravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | isa vargaṇāke pudgalaskandha hī jñānāvaraṇādi āṭha karmoṃ ke rūpase pariṇata hote haiṃ | yaha terahavīṃ vargaṇā hai |
utkṛṣṭa kārmaṇa vargaṇāmeṃ eka paramāṇukī vṛddhi honepara jaghanya dhruvaskandhadravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | punaḥ eka eka paramāṇukī vṛddhi karate hue satra jīvoṃse anantaguṇita sthāna āge jānepara utkṛṣṭa dhruvaskandha dravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | ye dhruvaskandhavargaṇāeṃ bhī agrāhya haiṃ | yaha caudahavīṃ vargaṇā hai |
utkṛṣṭa dhruvaskandha dravyavargaṇā meṃ eka paramāṇu ke milānepara jaghanyasāntara nirantara dravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai usake ūpara eka eka paramāṇukī vṛddhi karate hue saba jīvoṃse anantaguṇita sthāna āge jānepara utkṛṣṭa sāntaranirantaradravya vargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | yaha bhī agrahaṇavargaṇā hai, kyoṃki yaha āhāra, taijasa, bhāṣā ādike pariṇamana yogya nahīṃ hai | isa vargaṇāke paramāṇu jaghanyase lekara utkṛṣṭa taka antara sahita bhī pāye jāte haiṃ aura antara- rahita bhī pāye jāte haiṃ, isalie ise sāṃtaraniraṃtara dravyavargaṇā kahate haiṃ | yaha pandrahavīṃ vargaṇā hai |
prastāvanā
•
sāntara nirantara dravyavargaṇāoṃke ūpara dhruvaśūnyavargaṇā hotī hai | utkṛṣṭa sāntara nirantara dravyavargaṇāke ūpara eka paramāṇu adhika, do paramāṇu adhika ādike rūpase pudgalaparamāṇuskandha tīnoṃ hī kāloṃmeṃ nahīṃ pāye jāte | kintu saba jīvoṃse anantaguṇita sthāna āge jākara prathama dhruvaśūnyavargaṇākī utkṛṣṭa vargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | yaha solahavīṃ vargaṇā hai, jo sadā śūnyarūpase avasthita rahatī hai |

dhruvaśūnya vargaṇāoṃke ūpara eka paramāṇukī vṛddhi honepara jaghanya pratyeka śarīradravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai | eka eka jīvake eka eka śarīrameṃ upacita hue karma aura nokarmaskandhoṃko pratyeka śarīra dravyavargaṇā kahate haiṃ | yaha pratyeka śarīra pṛthivīkāyika, jalakāyika, agnikāyika, vāyukāyika, deva, nārakī, āhārakaśarīrī pramattasaṃyata aura kevalijinake pāyā jātā hai | ina āṭha prakārake jīvoṃke sivāya śeṣa jitane saṃsārī jīva haiṃ, unakā śarīra yā to nigoda jīvoṃse 1. pratiṣṭhita hone ke kāraṇa sapratiṣṭhita pratyekarūpa hai, yā svayaṃ nigodarūpa sādhāraṇa śarīra hai | kevala jo vanaspati nigoda - rahita hotī hai, vaha isakā apavāda hai | ūpara batalāī gaī yaha jaghanya pratyeka śarīradravyavargaṇā kṣapitakarmāśika jīvake caudahaveṃ guṇasthānake antima samayameṃ hotī hai | isa jaghanya pratyeka śarīradravyavargaṇāse eka eka paramāṇukī vṛddhi karate hue ananta sthāna āge jānepara utkṛṣṭa pratyeka śarīradravyavargaṇā prāpta hotī hai, jo mahāvanake dāhādike samaya eka bandhanabaddha agnikāyika jīvoṃ pāī jātī hai | yadyapi mahāvanādike dāha samaya jitane agnikāyika jīva hote hai, una sabakā pṛthak-pṛthak svataṃtra hī śarīra hotā hai, tathāpi ve saba jīva aura unake śarīra paraspara saṃyukta rahate haiṃ, isalie una sabakī eka vargaṇā mānī gaī hai | yaha satarahavīṃ vargaṇā hai |

aura gotrakarmakā to sarvabandha hī hotā hai, kyoṃki inakī prakṛtiyāṃ sapratipakṣī haiṃ, ataḥ eka sātha kisī bhī jīvake sabakā bandha sambhava nahīṃ hai| yaha prakṛtibandhakā varṇana huā| sthitibandhakī apekṣā jisakarmakī jitanī sarvotkṛṣṭa sthiti batalāī gaī hai, usa sabakā bandha karanā sarvabandha hai aura usase kama sthitikā bandha karanā nosarvabandha hai | anubhāgabandhakī apekṣā jisa karmameṃ anubhāga sambandhī sarva spardhaka pāye jāte hai, vaha sarvānubhāgabandha hai aura jisameṃ usase kama spardhaka pāye jāte haiṃ, vaha nosarvānubhāgabandha hai | pradeśabandhakī apekṣā vivakṣita karmake sarva pradeśakā baṃdha honā sarvabandha hai aura usase kama pradeśoṃkā bandha honā nosarvabandha hai |
(4-5) utkṛṣṭavandha-anutkṛṣṭabandhaprarūpaṇā- prakṛtibandhameṃ utkṛṣṭa -anutkṛṣṭa bandhakī prarūpaṇā sambhava nahīṃ hai| sthitibandhakī apekṣā jisa karmakī jitanī sarvotkṛṣṭa sthiti batalāī gaī hai, usake bandhako utkṛṣṭa bandha kahate haiṃ | jaise mohanīyakarmakā sattarakoḍākoḍī pramāṇa utkṛṣṭa sthitibandha honepara antima niṣekako utkṛṣṭa sthitibandha kahā jāyagā| utkṛṣṭa sthitibandhameṃse eka samaya kama ādi jitane bhī sthitike vikalpa haiṃ, unheṃ anutkṛṣṭa sthitibandha kahā jāyagā | anubhāgabandhakī apekṣā sarvotkṛṣṭa anubhāgako bāṃdhanā utkṛṣṭa bandha hai aura usase nyūna anubhāgako bāṃdhanā anutkṛṣṭabandha hai | pradeśa bandhakī apekṣā sarvotkṛṣṭa pradeśoṃkā bandha karanā utkṛṣṭa bandha hai aura usase kama pradeśoṃkā bandha karanā anutkṛṣṭa bandha hai|

( 1 ) ' aṭṭhāmiṇi -' ityādi dūsarī sūtragāthākī ṭīkā karate hue śaṃkā uṭhāī gaī hai| ki ' kathaṃ savvamidaṃ ṇavvade ?' arthāt yaha saba kisa pramāṇase jānā jātā hai ? to isake samādhāna meṃ kahā gayā hai ki ' uvari bhaṇṇamāṇacuṇṇisuttādo', arthāt āge kahe jānevāle cūrṇisūtrase jānā jātā hai | ( dekho dhavalā pu. 12, pṛ. 42-43 )
( 2 ) ' tiya' idi vutte ohiṇāṇāvaraṇīya
• samāṇāṇaṃ gahaṇaṃ | kadhaṃ samāṇattaṃ vade ? uvari bhaṇṇamāṇacuṇṇisuttādo | ( dhavalā pu. 12, pṛ. 43 )
isa uddharaṇameṃ bhī yahī śaṃkā uṭhāī gaī hai ki ' tiya ' padase avadhijñānāvaraṇīya ādi inhīṃ tīna prakṛtiyoṃkā kaise grahaṇa kiyā gayā hai yaha kaise jānā ? uttara diyā gayā - ki āge kahe jānevāle cūrṇisūtrase jānā |
uparyukta do uddharaṇoṃke prakāśameṃ yaha bāta asaṃdigdharūpa se siddha hotī hai ki una gāthāoṃ ke artha spaṣṭīkaraṇārtha jo gadyasūtroṃkī racanā kī gaī hai, unheṃ dhavalākāra 'cūrṇisūtra' kara rahe hai | ṭhīka vaise hī, jaise ki kasāyapāhuḍakī gāthāoṃ ke artha spaṣṭīkaraṇārtha yativṛṣabhācāryadvārā race gaye sūtroṃko unhīṃne [ vīrasenācāryane ] cūrṇisūtra kahā hai |
isake atirikta jaise yativṛṣabhācārya ne kasāyapāhuḍakī gāthāoṃkī vyākhyā karate hue ' vihāsā, vedāditi vihāsā' [ kasāyapāhuḍa sutta pṛ. 764-765 ] ityādi kaha kara punaḥ gāthāke arthako spaṣṭa karanevāle cūrṇisūtroṃkī racanā kī hai, ṭhīka usī prakārase ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake kitane hī sthaloṃpara hameṃ yahī bāta dṛṣṭigocara hotī hai, jisase hamāre ukta kathana kī aura bhī puṣṭi

ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgama pṛ. 586 para prathama kālavidhānacūlikā prārambha karate hue jo cāra anuyogadvāra jñātavya kahe haiṃ, ve aura una cāroṃkī prarūpaṇāke sūtra kammapayaḍīkī sthitibandhaprakaraṇavālī gā. 68-69 ke ādhāra para race gaye haiṃ| ve donoṃ gāthāeṃ isa prakāra haiṃ---
1 ṭhiibaṃdhaṭṭhāṇāī suhumaapajjattagassa thovāiṃ | bāyarasuhumeyara biticauridiyaamaṇasannīṇaṃ || 68 || saṃkhejjaguṇāṇi kamā asamattiyare ya biṃdiyāimmi | navaramasaṃkhejjaguṇāṇi saṃkilesā ya savvattha || 69 ||
( kammapayaḍī bandhanakaraṇa patra 160) yahāṃ yaha draṣṭavya hai ki jisa prakāra ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamameṃ sūtrāṃka 37 se 50 taka pahale sthitibandhasthānoṃkā alpabahutva kahā gayā hai, aura tatpaścāt sūtra 51 se 64 taka saṃkleśaviśuddhi sthānoṃkā alpabahutva kahā gayā hai, usakī sūcanā bhī dūsarī gāthāke caturtha caraṇa 'saṃkilesā ya savvattha' isa padase kara dī gaī hai | jisakā vistāra ā. bhūtabaline ukta sūtroṃkedvārā kiyā hai |
yahāṃ yaha bāta bhī dhyāna denekī hai ki ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake samānahī kammapayaḍīcūrṇimeṃ pahale sthitibandhādhyavasāyasthānoṃkā aura pīche saṃkleśaviśuddhisthānoṃkā alpabahutva ṭhīka unhī śabdoṃ meṃ diyā gayā hai| jisase ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake sūtroṃkā prabhāva kammapayaḍīkī cūrṇipara spaṣṭa lakṣita hotā hai|
ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake pṛ. 588 para sūtrāṅka 65 se 100 taka ke sūtroṃ dvārā jo sthitibandha sambandhī alpabahutva kahā gayā hai vaha kammapayaḍīkī sthitibandhasambandhī gā. 81-82 para ādhārita hai| ina gāthāoṃkī cūrṇimeṃ jo ukta alpabahutva diyā gayā hai vaha gāthāke vyākhyātmaka padoṃke sivāya ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake sūtroṃke sātha jyoṃkā tyoṃ sāmya rakhatā hai, jisake lie cūrṇi ukta sūtroṃkī ābhārī hai| ( dekho kammapayaḍī, sthiti baṃ. patra 174-175)

prastāvanā
kammapayaḍīkī uparyukta uddharaṇoṃ aura sāmya-sthaloṃke prakāśa meṃ sahajahī yaha praśna uṭhatā haiṃ ki, kyā ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamakārake sāmane kammapayaḍī thī, aura kyā use ādhāra banā karake unhoṃne apane granthakī racanā kī hai ?
yahāṃ yaha ākṣepa kiyā jā sakatā hai ki ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamakī racanā to vikramakī dūsarītīsarī śatābdī ke lagabhaga huī hai, jaba ki kammapayaḍī kī racanā ā. śivaśarmane vikramakī pāṃcavīṃ śatābdī ke āsa-pāsa kī hai, taba yaha kaise sambhava hai ki apanese paravartī racanākā upayoga ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamakāraneṃ kiyā ho ?
isa ākṣepakā samādhāna yaha hai ki śivaśarmakā samaya vikramakī pāṃcavīṃ śatābdī mānā jātā hai, yaha ṭhīka hai | aura yahabhī ṭhīka hai ki unhoṃne kammapayaḍīkā vartamānarūpameṃ saṃkalana pīche kiyā hai | para isa viṣaya meṃ kammapayaḍīkī cūrṇikārake nimna utthānikā vākya avalokanīya haiṃ | ve likhate haiṃ
imami jiṇasāsaṇe dussamābaleṇa khīyamāṇamehāusaddhā saṃvegaujjamāraṃbha ajjakāliya sāhujaṇaṃ aṇugvettukāmeṇa vicchinna kammapayaḍimahāgaṃtthattha saṃbohaṇatthaṃ āraddhaṃ āyarieṇaṃ tagguṇaṇāmagaṃ kammapayaḍīsaṃgahaṇī ṇāma pagaraṇaṃ | ( kammapayaḍī patra 1 )
arthāt duḥṣamā kālake prabhāvase jinakī buddhi, śraddhā, saṃvega aura udyama dina para dina kṣīṇa ho rahā hai, aise adya ( vartamāna ) kālika sādhujanoṃke anugrahake lie vicchinna hue mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍake granthārtha ke sambodhanārtha ācāryaneṃ usī guṇa aura nāmavāle isa karmaprakṛtisaṃgrahaṇī nāmaka prakaraṇa ko racā |
isa uddharaṇameṃ tīna mahattvapūrṇa bāte ullikhita haiṃ- pahalī to yaha ki isake viṣayakā sambandha usa mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍase hai, jo ki ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamakā bhī udgama ādhāra hai | dūsarī bāta yaha ki prakṛta kammapayaḍīke racane ke samaya vaha mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍa vicchinna ho gayā thā | tīsarī bāta yaha ki isakā pūrā nāma ' kammapayaḍisaṃgahaṇī ' hai | ' kammapayaḍī' padake pīche lagā huā ' saṃgahaṇī ' pada spaṣṭarūpase batā rahā hai ki usa vicchinna hue mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍakā jo kucha bhī bikharā huā

chakkhaṃḍāgama aṃśa ācārya-paramparāse unheṃ prāpta huā, vaha unhoṃne jyoṃ kā tyoṃ isameṃ saṃgraha kara diyā hai| isīse usakā ‘kammapayaḍīsaṃgahaṇī ' yaha nāma sārthaka hai |
ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamameṃ upalabdha aneka sūtra gāthāoṃse itanā to siddha hī hai ki vaha mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍa gāthāoṃ meṃ nibaddha rahā hai| usakī ve gāthāe~ dharasenācāryako prāpta thīṃ aura kaṇṭhastha bhī thīṃ| unhīṃko ādhāra banākara unhoṃne unakā vyākhyāna puṣpadanta aura bhūtabaliko kiyā| unhīṃke ādhāra para unhoṃne apanī ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgama kī racanā kī| prakaraṇa vaśa kahīṃ-kahīṃ unhoṃne gurumukhase sunī aura paḍha़ī huī gāthāoṃko likha diyā hai| usī mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍakī aneka gāthāe~-jinake ādhārapara unhoṃne ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamakī racanā kī hai -- ācārya-paramparāse ātī huī ā. śivaśarmako prāpta huī aura unhoṃne apanī racanāmeṃ unhe saṃkalita kara diyā- to itane mānase hī kyā ve unakī racī kahalāne lageṃgī| go. jīvakāṃḍa aura karmakāṇḍa meṃ aisī saikaḍoṃ . gāthāe~ haiṃ, jo usake racayitāse bahuta pahalese calī ā rahī haiṃ, mātra unake gommaṭasārameṃ saṃgraha honese to ve usake racayitā-dvārā racita nahīṃ mānī jā sakatī |
ukta sarva kathanakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki bhale hī kammapayaḍīkī racanā ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamase pīchekī rahī āve, parantu usameṃ aisī aneka gāthāe~ haiṃ, jo bahuta prācīna kālase calī ā rahīṃ thīṃ| unakā jñāna ṣaṭakhaṇḍāgamakārako thā aura unake ādhārapara amuka-amuka sthalake sūtroṃkā unhoṃne nirmāṇa kiyā, isake mānanemeṃ koī āpatti yā ākṣepakī bāta nahīṃ hai |
jīvasthānakā ādhāra
ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgamake chaha khaṇḍoṃmeṃ pahalā khaṇḍa jīvasthāna hai| isakā udgama dhavalākārane mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍake chaṭhe bandhana nāmaka anuyogadvārake cauthe bheda bandhavidhānake antargata vibhinna bheda-prabhedarūpa avāntara-adhikāroṃse batalāyā hai, yaha bāta hama prastāvanāke prārambhameṃ diye gaye citrādikoṃke dvārā spaṣṭa kara cuke haiṃ | jīvasthānakā mukhya viṣaya sat , saṃkhyādi āṭha prarūpaṇāoṃke dvārā jīvakī vividha avasthāoṃkā varṇana karanā hai| isameṃ to sandeha hī nahīṃ, ki jīvasthānakā mūla udgamasthāna mahākammapayaḍipāhuḍa thā| aura yataḥ karma-bandha karaneke nāte usake bandhaka jīvakā jabataka svarūpa, saṃkhyādi na jāna lie jāveṃ, taba taka karmoke bheda-prabhedoṃkā aura unake svarūpa ādikā varṇana karanā koī mahattva nahīṃ rakhatā, ataḥ bhagavat puṣpadantane sabase pahale jīvoṃke svarūpa ādikā sat , saṃkhyādi anuyogadvāroṃse varṇana karanā hī ucita samajhā| isa prakāra jīvasthānanāmaka prathama khaṇḍakī racanākā śrīgaṇeśa huā|

[109
isa prakāra dvādaśāṅga śrutameṃ vistārase kahe gaye aura mere dvārā samāsa ( saṃkṣepa ) se kahe gaye isa granthameṃ jo upayukta hokara usake arthakā guṇana (cintana aura manana ) karatā hai, usakī buddhi vipula ( viśāla ) ho jātī hai |

paḍhamakhaṃḍe jīvaṭṭhāṇe 1 saṃtaparūvaṇā
ṇamo arihaṃtāṇaṃ ṇamo siddhāṇaṃ ṇamo āiriyāṇaṃ | ṇamo uvajjhāyāṇaṃ ṇamo loe savvasāhūṇaṃ || 1 ||
arihaṃtoṃko namaskāra ho, siddhoṃko namaskāra ho, ācāryoṃko namaskāra ho, upādhyāyoṃko namaskāra ho aura lokameṃ sthita sarva sādhuoṃ ko namaskāra ho || 1 ||
arihanta- ari arthāt śatrusvarūpa mohake jo ghātaka haiṃ ve arihanta kahalāte haiṃ | athavā jo jñānāvaraṇa aura darśanāvaraṇarūpa rajake ghātaka haiṃ ve arihanta kahalāte haiṃ | abhiprāya yaha hai ki jo jñānāvaraṇa, darśanāvaraṇa, mohanīya aura antarāya ina cāra ghātiyā karmoko naṣṭa karake anantacatuṣṭayako prāpta kara cuke haiṃ ve arihanta kahalāte haiṃ |
siddha- jo jñānāvaraṇādi āṭhoṃ karmoṃko naṣṭa karake abhīṣṭa sādhyako siddha karate hue kṛtakṛtya ho cuke haiṃ ve siddha kahe jāte haiṃ | ukta āṭha karmoṃ ke naṣṭa ho jānepara siddhoṃmeṃ nimna āṭha guṇa svabhāvataḥ prakaṭa ho jāte haiṃ | kevalajñāna, kevaladarśana, avyābādhatva, samyaktva, avagāhanatva, sūkṣmatva, agurulaghutva aura anantavīrya |

ācārya - jo darśana, jñāna, cāritra tapa, aura vīryarūpa pāṃca prakārake ācārakā svayaṃ niraticāra ācaraṇa karate haiṃ tathā anya sādhuoṃko karāte haiṃ aura usakī śikṣā dete haiṃ ve ācārya kahalāte haiṃ | inameṃ kitane hī caudaha, dasa yā nau pūrvoke pāragāmī evaṃ tātkālika svasamaya va parasamayarūpa śrutake jñātā bhī hote haiṃ |
upādhyāya - jo dvādaśāṃgarūpa svādhyāyakā upadeśa dete haiṃ, athavā tātkālika pravacanakā vyākhyāna karate haiṃ ve upādhyāya kahalāte haiṃ |

2] chakkhaṃḍāgame jīvaṭṭhāṇaṃ
[ 1, 1, 2 sādhu- jo mokṣaprāptike kāraṇabhūta ratnatrayake siddha karanemeṃ sadā tatpara rahate haiṃ aura samasta prāṇiyoṃke viṣayameṃ samatābhāvako dhāraṇa karate haiṃ ve sādhu kahalāte haiṃ| graṃthārambhake pahile maṃgala, graṃtharacanākā kāraṇa, prayojana, graṃthakā pramāṇa, nāma aura kartā; ina chahake kathana karanekī ācāryaparaṃparāgata śailī hai| tadanusāra śrī puṣpadantācāryane ukta maṃgala ādike prarūpaṇārtha yaha maṃgalasūtra kahā hai | yaha maṃgalasūtra ṇamokāra-maṃtrake nāmase prasiddha hai | 'maṃ pāpaṃ gālayati iti maṃgalam' arthāt jo pāparūpa malakā gālana kare use maṃgala kahate haiṃ| dravyamala aura bhāvamalake bhedase mala do prakārakā hai| inameṃ dravyamala bhī do prakārakā hai- bāhya dravyamala aura abhyantara dravyamala | unameṃ pasīnā, dhūli aura mala-mūtra ādi bāhya dravyamala haiṃ| saghanarūpameṃ ātmāse sambaddha prakṛti, sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśa ina bhedoṃmeṃ vibhakta aise jñānāvaraṇādi āṭha prakārake karma abhyantara dravyamala kahe jāte haiṃ| ajñāna evaṃ adarśana ādi pariṇāmoṃko bhāvamala kahate haiṃ| athavā ' maṃga' śabdakā artha puṇya yā sukha hotā hai| ata eva ' maṃgaṃ sukhaṃ lāti ādatte iti maṃgalam' isa niruktike anusāra jo sukhako lātā hai use maṃgala kahate haiṃ|
aba caudaha guṇasthānoṃke anveṣaṇameṃ prayojanabhūta honese yahāṃ sarvaprathama gati ādi caudaha mārgaṇāoṃke jāna lenekī preraṇā kī jātī hai
etto imesiṃ codasaṇhaṃ jīvasamāsāṇaṃ maggaṇaṭṭhadāe tattha imāṇi coddasa ceva ṭṭhāṇāṇi ṇāyavvāṇi bhavaṃti || 2||
___ yahāṃ ina caudaha jīvasamāsoṃ arthāt mithyātvādi guṇasthānoṃkī prarūpaṇāmeṃ jīvoṃke anveṣaṇameṃ prayojanabhūta honese ye caudaha mārgaṇāsthāna jāna leneke yogya haiṃ ||2||
jīvāḥ samasyante saṃkṣipyante eṣu iti jīvasamāsāḥ' isa niruktike anusāra jinameṃ anantānanta jīvoṃkā saṃkṣepa kiyā jātā hai unheṃ jīvasamāsa kahate haiṃ | isa prakāra yahāṃ jīvasamāsase caudaha guṇasthānoṃkā grahaṇa hotā hai | mārgaṇā, gaveṣaṇa aura anveṣaṇa ye samānārthaka śabda haiṃ | jahāṃpara yā jinake dvārā sat-saṃkhyā ādi āṭha anuyogadvāroṃse saṃyukta uparyukta caudaha guṇasthānoṃkā anveṣaṇa kiyā jātā hai ve mārgaṇāsthāna kahe jāte haiṃ|
taṃ jahā ||3|| ve mārgaṇāyeṃ isa prakāra haiṃ || 3 ||
gai iṃdie kāe joge vede kasāe ṇāṇe saṃjame daṃsaṇe lessā bhaviya sammatta saṇṇi āhārae cedi || 4 ||
gati, indriya, kāya, yoga, veda, kaṣāya, jñāna, saṃyama, darśana, leśyā, bhavyatva, samyaktva, saṃjñī aura āhāra; ye ve caudaha mārgaṇāyeṃ haiṃ || 4 ||
1 gati- jo prāpta kī jāya use gati kahate haiṃ| athavā, eka bhavase dūsare bhavameṃ jāneko gati kahate haiṃ | athavā gatināmaka nāmakarmake udayase jo jīvakī avasthāviśeṣa utpanna hotī hai use

1, 1, 4] saṃtaparūvaṇāe maggaṇāsarūpaṃ
[3 gati kahate haiṃ | sāmānyarūpase vaha gati cāra prakārakī hai- devagati, manuṣyagati, tiryaṃcagati aura narakagati|
2 indriya- cūṃki sparśanādi indriyāṃ indra ke samāna apane apane viṣayake grahaṇa karane meṃ svayaṃ hī samartha haiṃ, ataeva unheṃ indriya śabdase saṃbodhita kiyā jātā hai| athavā indrakā artha ātmā hotā hai, usa ātmāke jo liṃga yā cinha haiṃ unheṃ indriyāṃ kahate haiṃ|
3 kāya- pṛthivī ādi nāmakarmoke udayase jo saṃcita hotā hai usakā nāma kāya hai| athavā yogarūpa ātmākī pravṛttise saṃcayako prāpta hue audārikādirūpa pudgalapiṃḍako kāya samajhanā cāhiye | vaha kāya pṛthivīkāya ādike bhedase chaha prakārakā hai | ve pṛthivī ādi chaha kāya trasakāya aura sthāvarakāya ina do bhedoṃmeṃ antarhita haiṃ |
4 yoga- śarīra nāmakarmake udayake anusāra mana, vacana aura kāyase saṃyukta jīvakī jisa śaktike nimittase karmakā āgamana hotā hai use yoga kahate haiṃ|
___ 5 veda- veda karmake udayase jīva bhinna bhinna bhāvoṃkā (strībhāva, puruṣabhāva, napuṃsakabhāvakā) jo vedana karatā hai use veda kahate haiṃ|
6 kaṣāya- jo sukha va duḥkha ādirūpa aneka prakārake dhānyako utpanna karanevāle karmarūpī kṣetrako karṣaṇa karate haiṃ unheṃ kaṣāya kahate haiṃ|
7 jñāna- jisake dvārā jīva trikālavartī samasta dravya, unake guṇa aura aneka prakārakī paryāyoṃko pratyakṣa athavā parokṣa rūpase jānatā hai usako jñāna kahate haiṃ |
8 saṃyama- ahiṃsādi vratoṃkā dhāraṇa karanā, īryā-bhāṣādirūpa samitiyoṃkā paripālana karanā, krodhādi kaṣāyoṃkā jītanā, anarthadaṇḍoṃkā parityāga karanā aura pāṃcoṃ indriyoṃkā damana karanā; isakā nāma saṃyama hai | abhiprāya yaha hai ki tyājya viṣayase jo nivṛtti aura grāhya viṣayameṃ jo pravṛtti hotī hai use saṃyama kahate haiṃ|
9 darśana- sāmānya-viśeṣātmaka ātmasvarūpakā jo avabhāsana hotā hai use darśana kahate haiṃ | āgamameṃ antarmukha citprakāśako darśana aura bahirmukha citprakāśako jñāna mānā gayā hai | abhiprāya yaha hai ki jñānakī utpattimeṃ nimittabhūta jo prayatna hotā hai tadrūpase pariṇata ātmāke saṃvedanako darśana aura tatpaśścāt bāhya padārthake viṣayameṃ jo vikalparūpa grahaṇa hotā hai use jñāna samajhanā cāhiye | yahī ina donomeṃ bheda bhī hai|
10 leśyā- jisake dvārā jīva puṇya aura pāpase apaneko lipta karatā hai usakā nāma leśyā hai | yaha leśyā śabdakā niruktatyartha hai | tātparya yaha ki kaṣāyānuraṃjita jo yogoṃkī pravṛtti hotī hai use leśyā kahate haiṃ|

chakkhaṃḍāgame jīvaṭṭhāṇaṃ
[1, 1,5 11 bhavyatva- jina jīvoṃke liye bhaviṣyameṃ mukti prāpta karanā saṃbhava hai yā jo tadviṣayaka yogyatā rakhate haiṃ unhe bhavya jīva kahate haiṃ | tathā jo kisī bhī samaya mukti prāpta nahīṃ kara sakate haiṃ yā jina jīvoṃmeṃ vaisī yogyatā nahīṃ hai unheṃ abhavya jīva kahate haiṃ |
12 samyaktva- āpta, āgama aura padārtharūpa tattvārthake śraddhānakā nāma samyaktva hai| abhiprāya yaha hai ki jinendra bhagavānke dvārā upadiṣṭa chaha dravya, pāṃca astikāya aura nava padārthokā, ājñā aura adhigamase jo śraddhāna hotā hai use samyaktva kahate haiṃ||
13 saṃjñī- jo jīva manake avalaṃbanase śikṣā, kriyā, upadeśa aura ālāpako grahaṇa kara sakate haiṃ unheṃ saṃjñī tathā jo ukta śikṣā ādiko grahaṇa nahīṃ kara sakate haiṃ unheṃ asaṃjñī kahate haiṃ | ' samyak jānāti iti saṃjñam ' isa niruktike anusāra · saṃjña' śabdakā artha mana hotā hai | vaha jina jīvoṃke pāyā jātā hai unheṃ saṃjñī aura ukta manase rahita jīvoṃko asaṃjñī samajhanā cāhiye |
14 āhāraka- jo jīva audārika, vaikriyika aura āhāraka ina tīna śarīra tathā chaha paryāptiyoṃke yogya pudgalavargaṇāoṃko grahaṇa karate haiṃ unheṃ āhāraka kahate haiṃ| tathā isa prakārake āhārake na grahaṇa karanevāle jīva anāhāraka kahe jāte haiṃ | vigrahagatiko prāpta cāroṃ gatike jīva, pratara aura lokapūraṇa samuddhātako prāpta hue sayogakevalī, ayogakevalī evaṃ siddha bhagavān anāhāraka hote haiṃ | inake sivāya śeṣa jīvoṃko āhāraka jānanā cāhiye |
aba una khoje jānevāle jīvasamāsoṃ ( guṇasthānoṃ ) ke anuyogadvāroṃkī prarūpaṇā karaneke liye āgekā sūtra kahate haiṃ -
edesiṃ ceva codasaṇhaṃ jīvasamāsāṇaṃ parūvaṇadvadāe tattha imāṇi aṭṭha aṇiyogadārāṇi ṇāyavyāṇi bhavaṃti || 5 ||
inhīṃ caudaha jīvasamāsoṃkī prarūpaṇārūpa prayojanakī siddhimeṃ sahāyaka honese yahāṃ ye āṭha anuyogadvāra jānane yogya haiṃ || 5||
taṃ jahā || 6 || ve āṭha anuyogadvāra isa prakāra haiṃ || 6 ||
saṃtaparūvaṇā davvapamāṇāṇugamo khettāṇugamo phosaṇāṇugamo kālāṇugamo aṃtarāṇugamo bhāvāṇugamo appābahugāṇugamo cedi || 7 ||
satprarūpaṇā, dravyapramāṇānugama, kṣetrānugama, sparśanānugama, kālānugama, antarānugama, bhāvānugama aura alpabahutvānugama ye ve āṭha anuyogadvāra haiṃ || 7 ||
1 satprarūpaṇā- utpāda, vyaya aura dhrauvya svarūpa astitvakā pratipādana karanevālī prarūpaṇāko satprarūpaṇā kahate haiṃ | (2) dravyapramāṇānugama- satprarūpaṇā dvārā jinakā astitva jñāta ho cukā hai unhīṃke pramāṇako prarūpaṇā dravyapramāṇānugama aniyogadvāra karatā hai | (3) kṣetrānugama

1, 1, 10] saṃtaparūvaṇāe oghaṇiddeso
[5 isa anuyogadvārameṃ unhīṃkī vartamāna avagāhanākī prarūpaṇā kī jātī hai | (4) sparśanānugama- unake hī atītakālaviśiṣṭa sparśakā varṇana karatā hai | (5) kālānugama- jisameṃ ukta dravyoṃkī jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭa sthitikā varṇana ho use kālānugama kahate haiṃ | (6) antarānugama- jina dravyoṃke
stitvādikā jñāna ho cukā hai unhīṃke antarakālakī prarūpaṇā antarānugama anuyogadvāra karatā hai| (7) bhāvānugama- ukta dravyoṃke bhāvakī prarūpaṇā karanevāle anuyogadvārakā nāma bhāvānugama anuyogadvāra hai| (8) alpabahutvānugama- alpabahutva anuyogadvāra eka dūsarekī apekṣā unhīṃ dravyoṃkī hīnādhikatākā nirūpaṇa karatā hai |
aba pahale satprarūpaṇāke svarūpakā nirūpaṇa karaneke liye sūtra kahate haiṃ..... saṃtaparūvaṇadāe duviho ṇiddeso ogheṇa ādeseṇa ya ||8|| satprarūpaṇāmeṃ oghakī apekṣā aura ādeśakī apekṣā nirdeśa do prakārakā hotā hai ||8||
nirdeśa śabdakā artha prarūpaṇā yā vyākhyāna hotā hai | oghase abhiprāya sāmānya aura ādeśase abhiprāya viśeṣakā hai | sūtrakā artha karate samaya yahāṃ pūrva sūtrokta 'coddasaṇhaṃ jīvasamāsāṇaṃ' isa padakī anuvṛtti karanī cāhiye | isaliye usakā yaha artha hotā hai ki caudaha jīvasamāsoṃke sattvakā nirūpaṇa ogha aura ādeśa ina do prakāroṃse kiyā jātā hai | jīva jina audayikādi bhāvoṃmeṃ bhale prakārase rahate haiṃ unheṃ jīvasamāsa kahate haiṃ| ve audayikādi bhāva ye haiṃ-- jo bhāva karmoke upaśamase utpanna hotā hai use aupaśamika bhāva kahate haiṃ | jo karmoke kṣayase utpanna hotā hai use kṣāyika bhāva kahate haiṃ | jo bhāva koṃke kṣaya aura upaśamase hotā hai use kṣāyopaśamika bhāva kahate haiṃ| abhiprāya yaha hai ki vivakṣita karmaprakṛtike sarvaghātī spardhakoṃke udayakṣaya, usīke sadavasthārūpa upaśama, tathā deśaghātī spardhakoṃke udayase jo bhāva utpanna hotā hai use kṣāyopaśamika bhāva kahā jātā hai | jo bhāva koṃke udaya, upaśama, kṣaya aura kṣayopaśamakī apekṣāke vinā jīvake khabhāvamātrase utpanna hotā hai use pāriṇāmika bhāva kahate haiṃ|
aba ogha arthāt guṇasthānaprarūpaṇakā kathana karaneke liye āgekā sūtra kahate haiṃogheṇa atthi micchāiṭṭī ||9|| sāmānyase mithyādṛṣṭi jīva haiṃ || 9||
mithyā, vitatha, alīka aura asatya ye ekārthavācī nāma haiṃ| dṛṣṭi śabdakā artha darśana yā śraddhāna hotā hai | isase yaha tātparya huā ki jina jīvoṃke viparīta, ekānta, vinaya, saṃśaya aura ajñānarūpa mithyātvakarmake udayase utpanna huī dṛṣṭi mithyā hotī hai unheṃ mithyādṛṣṭi jīva kahate haiṃ |
aba dūsare guṇasthānakā kathana karaneke liye āgekā sūtra kahate haiṃ - sāsaṇasammāiṭṭhī || 10 || sāmānyase sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva haiṃ || 10 ||

chakkhaṃḍāgame jīvaṭṭhāṇaṃ
[1, 1, 11 | samyaktvakī virādhanāko āsādana kahate haiṃ | jo isa āsādanase yukta hai use sāsādana kahate haiṃ | abhiprāya yaha ki anantānubandhicatuṣkameṃse kisī ekakā udaya honepara jisakā samyagdarśana naṣṭa ho gayā hai, kintu jo mithyātva karmake udayase utpanna honevāle mithyātvarūpa pariṇāmoṃko prāpta nahīṃ huvā hai aise mithyātva guṇasthānake abhimukha hue jīvako sāsādana kahate haiṃ |
- aba samyagmithyādṛṣṭi guṇasthānakā pratipādana karaneke liye sūtra kahate haiṃ -----
sammāmicchāiṭṭhī || 11 || sāmānyase samyagmithyādṛṣṭi jīva haiṃ || 11 ||
dṛṣṭi, śraddhā, ruci aura pratyaya ye paryāyavācī nāma haiṃ | jisa jīvake samīcīna aura mithyā donoṃ prakārakī dṛṣṭi hotī hai usako samyagmithyādṛṣṭi kahate haiṃ| jisa prakāra dahī aura guḍako milā denepara unake svādako pṛthak nahīṃ kiyā jā sakatā hai, kintu unakā milā huā svāda miśrabhāvako prāpta hokara jātyantarasvarūpa hotā hai usī prakāra samyaktva aura mithyātvarūpa mile hue pariṇāmoṃkā nāma miśra guṇasthāna hai| mithyātva prakṛtike udayase jisa prakāra samyaktvakā niranvaya nāśa hotā hai usa prakāra samyagmithyātva prakṛtike udayase samyaktvakā niranvaya nāśa nahīṃ hotā | isa guṇasthānameṃ mithyātva prakṛtike sarvaghātī spardhakoṃkā udayakṣaya, unhīṃkā sadavasthārūpa upaśama tathā samyagmithyātva prakṛtike sarvaghātī spardhakoṃkā udaya rahanese kṣāyopaśamika bhāva rahatā hai| athavā samyaktva prakṛtike deśaghātī spardhakoṃkā udayakṣaya, unhīṃke sadavasthārūpa upaśama tathā mithyātva prakṛtike sarvaghātī spardhakoṃkā udaya rahanese kṣāyopaśamika bhāva rahatā hai | - aba samyagdṛṣṭi guṇasthānakā nirūpaṇa karaneke liye uttara sūtra kahate haiṃ
asaṃjadasammāiṭṭhī || 12 || sāmānyase asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva haiṃ || 12 ||
jisakī dṛṣṭi samīcīna hotī hai use samyagdṛṣṭi kahate haiṃ aura saṃyamarahita samyagdṛṣṭiko asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi kahate haiṃ| ve samyagdṛṣṭi jīva tīna prakārake haiṃ. kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭi, vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi (kṣāyopaśamikasamyagdṛṣṭi) aura aupaśamikasamyagdṛṣṭi | anantānubandhī cāra aura mithyātva, samyagmithyātva tathā samyaktva ina sāta prakṛtiyoṃke sarvathā vināśase jīva kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭi hotā hai | inhīṃ sāta prakṛtiyoṃke upaśamase vaha upaśamasamyagdṛṣṭi tathā samyaktva prakṛtike udayase vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi hotā hai | yaha vedakasamyaktva- mithyātva aura samyagmithyātvake udayakṣaya aura sadavasthārūpa upaśamase tathā samyaktva prakṛtike deśaghātī spardhakoṃke udayase huā karatā hai, isīliye isako kṣāyopaśamika samyagdarśana kahā jātā hai|
kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva kabhī mithyātvako nahīṃ prāpta hotā| kintu upaśamasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva pariṇāmoṃke nimittase upaśama samyaktvako choḍa़kara mithyātvako prāpta ho jātā hai | vaha kabhī sāsādana

manoyoga cāra prakārakā hai - satyamanoyoga, mṛṣāmanoyoga, satyamṛṣāmanoyoga aura asatyamṛṣāmanoyoga || 49 ||

praśna- kevalī bhagavān ke satyamanoyogakā sadbhāva rahā āve, kyoṃki, vahāṃ para vastuke yathārtha jñānakā sadbhāva pāyā jātā hai | paraṃtu unake asatyamṛṣāmanoyogakā sadbhāva saṃbhava nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki, vahāṃpara saṃśaya aura anadhyavasāyarūpa jñānakā abhāva hai ?
uttara--- aisā nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki, vahāṃpara saṃśaya aura anadhyavasāya ke kāraṇa bhūta vacanakā kāraṇa mana honese usameṃ bhī anubhaya rūpa dharma raha sakatā hai | ataḥ sayogī jinameṃ anubhayamanoyogakā sadbhāva svīkāra kara lene meṃ koī virodha nahīṃ ātā hai |

[1, 1, 54 uttara- yaha koī ekānta nahīṃ hai ki saṃpūrṇa vacana manase hī utpanna hoṃ| kāraṇa ki yadi saṃpūrṇa vacanoṃkī utpatti manase hī mānī jāya to aisī avasthāmeṃ manarahita kevaliyoṃke vacanoṃkā abhāva prāpta ho jāyagā| isīliye dvīndriyase lekara asaṃjñī paṃcendriya paryaṃta jīvoṃke manake na rahanepara bhī vacana hotā hai | yadi kahā jāya ki vikalendriya jīvoṃke manake vinā cūṃki jñānakī utpatti nahīṃ ho sakatī hai, isaliye jñānake vinā unake vacanakī bhī pravṛtti saṃbhava nahīṃ hai; so yaha kahanā bhī ṭhīka nahīṃ hai; kyoṃki manase hī jñānakī utpatti hotī hai, yaha koī ekānta nahīṃ hai | yadi manase hī jñānakī utpatti hotī hai, aisā ekānta māna liyā jātā hai to phira usa avasthāmeṃ saṃpūrṇa indriyoṃse jñānakī utpatti nahīṃ ho sakegī| mana indriyoṃkā sahāyaka bhī nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki, prayatna aura ātmāke sahakārakī apekṣā rakhanevālī indriyoṃse indriyajñānakī utpatti pāī jātī hai|

usa eka hī vratakā cheda arthāt do tīna ādike bhedase upasthāpana arthāt vratoṃke dhāraṇa karaneko chedopasthāpanāśuddhisaṃyama kahate haiṃ| yaha chedopasthāpanāśuddhisaṃyama paryāyārthika nayakī apekṣā rakhanevālā hai|
jisake hiṃsākā parihāra hī pradhāna hai aise śuddhiprāpta saṃyatako parihāraśuddhisaṃyata kahate haiṃ | viśeṣatāse jisane tīsa varṣa taka apanī icchānusāra bhogoṃko bhogate hue sāmānya aura viśeṣarūpase saṃyamako dhāraṇa kara pratyākhyāna pūrvakā abhyāsa kiyā hai tathā jisake tapoviśeṣase parihāraṛddhi utpanna ho cukī hai aisā jīva tīrthaṃkarake pādamūlameṃ parihāraśuddhisaṃyamako grahaṇa karatā hai | isa saṃyamako dhāraṇa karanevālā khaḍa़e hone, gamana karane, bhojana-pāna karane aura baiṭhane ādi saṃpūrṇa vyāpāroṃ meṃ prāṇiyoṃkī hiṃsāke parihārameṃ samartha hotā hai|
sāṃparāya ' nāma kaṣāyakā hai | jinakī kaṣāya sūkṣma ho gaī hai ve sūkṣmasāṃparāya kahe jāte haiṃ | jo sūkṣma kaṣāyavāle hote hue śuddhi-prāpta saṃyata haiṃ unheṃ sūkṣmasāṃparāya-śuddhisaṃyata kahate haiṃ | isakā tātparya yaha hai ki sāmāyika aura chedopasthāpanā saṃyamako dhāraṇa karanevāle sādhu jaba kaṣāyako atiśaya sūkṣma kara lete haiṃ taba ve sūkṣmasāṃparāya-śuddhi-saṃyata kahalāte haiṃ |
jinake paramāgamameṃ pratipādita vihāra arthāt kaṣāyoṃke abhāvarūpa anuṣṭhāna pāyā jātā hai unheṃ yathākhyātavihāra kahate haiṃ | jo yathākhyātavihāravāle hote hue śuddhi-prāpta saṃyata haiṃ ve yathākhyāta-vihāra-śuddhisaṃyata kahalāte haiṃ|
___ jo pāṃca aṇuvrata, tīna guṇavrata aura cāra śikṣāvratoṃse saṃyukta hote hue karmanirjarā karate haiṃ aise samyagdṛṣṭi jīva saṃyatāsaṃyata kahe jāte haiṃ | unake darśanika, vratika, sāmāyikī, proṣadhopavāsī, sacittavirata, rātribhuktavirata, brahmacārī, ārambhavirata, parigrahavirata, anumativirata aura uddiṣṭavirata; ye gyāraha bheda haiṃ|
jo jīva chaha kāyake prāṇiyoṃ evaṃ indriyaviṣayoṃmeṃ virata nahīṃ hote haiṃ unheṃ asaṃyata jānanā cāhiye|
aba saṃyatoṃmeṃ guṇasthānoṃkī saṃkhyākā nirūpaṇa karaneke liye sūtra kahate haiṃ--- saṃjadā pamattasaṃjadappahuḍi jāva ajogikevali tti || 124 || saṃyata jīva pramattasaṃyatase lekara ayogikevalī guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ | 124 || aba saṃyamake guṇasthānoṃkā pratipādana karane ke liye sūtra kahate haiṃsāmāiyacchedovaṭṭhāvaṇasuddhisaṃjadā pamattasaṃjadappa huḍi jāva aṇiyaṭṭi ti||125||
sāmāyika aura chedopasthāpanārūpa śuddhiko prāpta hue saṃyata jīva pramattasaṃyatase lekara anivṛttikaraṇa guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ || 125 ||

cedi || 131 ||

1, 1, 136 ]
saṃtaparūvaṇāra lessāmaggaṇā
[ 43
ātmasaṃvedanameṃ ‘ maiṃ rūpake avalokanameṃ samartha hūṃ ' isa prakārake upayogako cakṣudarśana kahate haiṃ | cakṣu indriyako choḍa़kara śeṣa cāra indriyoṃ aura manase honevāle darśanako acakṣudarśana kahate haiṃ | avadhijñānake pūrva honevāle darśanako avadhidarśana kahate haiṃ | pratipakṣase rahita jo darśana hotā hai use kevaladarśana kahate haiṃ |
aba cakṣudarśana sambandhī guṇasthānoṃkā pratipādana karaneke liye sūtra kahate haiṃ --- cakkhudaṃsaṇī cauriṃdiya pahuḍi jāva khīṇakasāya- vīyarāya-chadumatthā ti || 132|| cakṣudarśanī jīva caturindriyase lekara kṣīṇakaṣāya-chamastha - vītarāga guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ ||
aba acakṣudarśanake svāmīko batalāne ke liye uttarasūtra kahate haiṃacakkhudaṃsaṇī eiṃdiya pahuḍi jāva khīṇakasāya - vīyarāya-chadumatthā tti || 133 || acakṣudarśanī jīva ekendriya se lekara kṣīṇakapāya - vītarāga chadmastha guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ | aba avadhidarśana sambandhī guṇasthānoṃkā pratipādana karane ke liye uttarasūtra kahate haiṃodhidaṃsaṇī asaṃjada sammāiṭṭhippa huḍi jāva khīṇakasāya- vīyarāga chadumatthā ti || avadhidarśanī jīva asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭise lekara kṣīṇakaṣāya- vītarāga chadmastha guṇasthāna taka
hote haiṃ || 134 ||
aba kevaladarśana ke svāmīkā pratipādana karaneke liye uttarasūtra kahate haiṃkevalasaṇī tisu āṇesu sajogikevalī ajogikevalī siddhā cedi || 135 || kevaladarśanī jīva sayogikevalī, ayogikevalī aura siddha ina tīna sthānoṃmeṃ hote haiṃ || aba śyāmārgaṇāke dvārā jīvoṃkā anveṣaṇa karaneke liye uttarasūtra kahate haiṃlessāvāde asthi kiṇhalessiyā ṇīlalessiyā kāulessiyā teulessiyā pammalessiyā sukkalessiyā alessiyā cedi || 136 ||
leśyāmārgaṇāke anuvādase kṛṣṇaleśyā, nīlaleśyā, kāpotaleśyā, tejoleśyā, padmaleśyā aura śuklaleśyāvāle tathā aleśyāvāle jīva hote haiṃ || 136 ||
kaṣāyase anuraṃjita jo yogoṃkī pravṛtti hotī hai use leśyā kahate haiṃ | ' karmaskandhaiḥ ātmānaṃ limpati iti leśyā ' isa niruktike anusāra jo karmaskandhoṃse ātmāko lipta karatī hai vaha leśyā hai, yaha ' leśyā ' śabdakā niruktyartha hai | yahāṃ kaṣāya aura yoga inakī jātyantarakharūpa miśra avasthāko leśyā kahaneke kāraṇa isa mārgaṇāko kaṣāya aura yoga mārgaṇāse pṛthak samajhanā cāhiye | itanā viśeṣa hai ki kaṣāyase anuraṃjita hī yogapravṛttiko leśyā nahīṃ samajhanā cāhiye, kyoṃki, aisā svīkāra karanepara sayogikevalī ke leśyārahita honekā prasaṃga ātā hai | parantu aisā hai nahīṃ, kāraṇa ki āgamameṃ sayogikevalīke yogakā sadbhāva honese śuklaleśyā nirdiṣṭa kī gaī hai |

44 ] chakkhaṃḍāgame jīvaṭṭhāṇaṃ
[ 1, 1, 136 kaṣāyakā udaya chaha prakārakā hotā hai- tīvratama, tīvratara, tīvra, manda, mandatara aura mandatama | isa chaha prakārake kaṣāyodayase utpanna huī leśyā bhī paripāṭīkramase chaha prakārakī hotī haikṛṣṇaleśyā, nīlaleśyā, kāpotaleśyā, tejoleśyā, padmaleśyā aura śuklaleśyā | ina leśyāoṃse saṃyukta jīvoṃkī pahicāna isa prakārase hotī hai
1. jo tīvra krodha karanevālā ho, vairako na choḍe, laḍanā jisakā khabhāva ho, dharma aura dayāse rahita ho, duṣṭa ho, kisīke vaśameṃ nahīṃ hotā ho, khacchaṃda ho, kāma karane meṃ manda ho, vartamāna . kārya karanemeṃ viveka rahita ho, kalācāturyase rahita ho, pāṃca indriyoṃke viṣayoṃmeṃ lampaṭa ho, mānī ho, māyāvī ho, ālasī ho, tathā ḍarapoka ho, aise jīvako kṛṣṇaleśyāvālā jānanā cāhiye |
2. jo atiśaya nidrālu ho, dūsaroṃke ṭhaganemeṃ dakṣa ho, aura dhana-dhānyake viṣayameṃ tīvra lālasā rakhatā ho use nīlaleśyāvālā jānanā cāhiye |
3. jo dūsareke ūpara krodha kiyā karatā hai, dūsaroṃkī nindā karatā hai, aneka prakārase dūsaroṃko duḥkha detā hai, unheṃ doṣa lagātā hai, atyadhika śoka aura bhayase saṃtapta rahatā hai, dūsaroṃkā utkarṣa sahana nahīṃ karatā hai, dūsaroṃkā tiraskāra karatā hai, apanī aneka prakārase praśaṃsā karatā hai, dūsareke ūpara viśvāsa nahīṃ karatā hai, apane samāna dūsareko bhī mānatā hai, stuti karanevālepara saṃtuṣṭa ho jātā hai, apanī aura dūsarekī hāni va vṛddhiko nahīṃ jānatā hai, yuddhameṃ maranekī abhilāṣā karatā hai, stuti karanevāleko bahuta dhana detā hai, tathā kārya-akāryakī kucha bhī gaṇanā nahīṃ karatā hai; use kāpotaleśyāvālā jānanā cāhiye |
4. jo kārya-akārya aura sevya-asevyako jānatā hai, saba viṣayameṃ samadarśī rahatā hai, dayā aura dānameṃ tatpara rahatā hai; tathā mana, vacana va kāyase komalapariṇāmī hotā hai; use pītaleśyāvālā jānanā cāhiye |
5. jo tyāgī hai, bhadrapariṇāmī hai, nirantara kārya karanemeṃ udyukta rahatā hai, jo aneka prakārake kaṣṭaprada upasargoko śāntise sahatā hai, aura sādhu tathā guru janoṃkī pūjāmeṃ rata rahatā hai; use padmaleśyāvālā jānanā cāhiye |
6. jo pakṣapāta nahīṃ karatā hai nidāna nahīṃ bāṃdhatā hai, sabake sātha samāna vyavahāra karatā hai, tathā iṣṭa aura aniṣṭa padārthoke viṣayameṃ rāga aura dveṣase rahita hotā hai; use śuklaleśyāvālā jānanā cāhiye|
jo ina chaha leśyāoṃse rahita ho cuke haiṃ unheṃ leśyārahita (aleśya ). jānanā cāhiye | aba leśyāoṃke guṇasthāna batalāneke liye uttarasūtra kahate haiṃ
kiṇhalessiyā ṇīlalessiyā kāulessiyā eiṃdiyappahuḍi jāva asaṃjadasammāiṭṭi ti || 137 ||

1, 1, 143] saṃtaparūvaṇāe lessāmaggaṇā
[ 45 kṛṣṇaleśyā, nīlaleśyā aura kāpotaleśyāvāle jīva ekendriyase lekara asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ || 137 ||
aba tejoleśyā aura padmaleśyāke guṇasthāna batalāneke liye uttarasūtra kahate haiṃ
teulessiyā pammalessiyā saṇṇimicchāiṭṭhippahuḍi jāva appamattasaṃjadā tti || 138 ||
tejoleśyā aura padmaleśyāvāle jīva saṃjñī mithyādṛṣṭi se lekara apramattasaṃyata guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ || 138 ||
aba śuklaleśyāke guṇasthāna batalāte haiṃ--- sukkalessiyā saṇṇimicchāiṭippahuḍi jāva sajogikevali tti || 139 || śuklaleśyāvāle jīva saṃjñī mithyādṛṣṭise lekara sayogikevalī guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ ||139||
yahāṃ śaṃkā ho sakatī hai ki jo jīva kaṣāyase rahita ho cuke haiṃ unake śuklaleśyā kaise sambhava hai ? isakā uttara yaha hai ki jina jīvoṃkī kaṣāya kṣīṇa athavā upaśānta ho gaī hai unameṃ karmalepakā kāraṇabhūta cūṃki yoga pāyā jātā hai, isa apekṣāse unake śuklaleśyākā sadbhāva mānā gayā hai|
aba leśyārahita jīvoṃkā nirūpaṇa karate haiṃteṇa paramalessiyā || 140 || terahaveṃ guṇasthānake āge sabhī jīva leśyārahita hote haiṃ || 140 ||
isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki vahāṃpara bandhake kāraṇabhūta yoga aura kaṣāya donoṃkā hī abhāva ho cukā hai|
aba bhavyamārgaṇāke dvārā jīvoṃke astitvakā pratipādana karaneke liye sūtra kahate haiṃbhaviyāṇuvādeṇa asthi bhavasiddhiyā abhavasiddhiyā || 141 || bhavyamārgaṇāke anuvādase bhavyasiddha aura abhavyasiddha jīva hote haiṃ ||141||
jina jīvoṃke bhaviṣyameṃ anantacatuṣṭayarūpa siddhi honevālī hai unheṃ bhavyasiddha ( bhavya) __ kahate haiṃ tathā jo usa anantacatuṣṭayarūpa siddhikī yogyatāse rahita haiṃ unheṃ abhavya samajhanā cāhiye |
aba bhavya jīvoṃke guṇasthāna kahe jāte haiṃbhavasiddhiyā eiṃdiyappahuḍi jāva ajogikevali tti || 142|| bhavyasiddha jīva ekendriyase lekara ayogikevalī guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ || 142 || aba abhavya jīvoṃke guṇasthānakā nirūpaṇa karate haiṃabhavasiddhiyā eiṃdiyappahuḍi jāva saṇṇimicchāiṭṭi tti || 143 ||

chakkhaṃḍāgame jīvadvāṇaṃ
[ 1, 1, 143
abhavyasiddhika jīva ekendriyase lekara saṃjñī mithyādṛṣṭi guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ || 143 || aba samyaktvamārgaṇāke anuvāda se jīvoṃke astitvakā pratipādana karaneke liye sūtra
samatāṇuvādeṇa asthi sammāiṭṭhī khaiyasammāiṭṭhī vedagasammāiṭṭhī uvasamasammāsāsaṇasammāṭṭhī sammāmicchāiṭṭhī micchāiṭṭhī cedi || 144 ||
samyaktvamārgaṇāke anuvāda se samyagdṛṣṭi, kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭi, vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi, upaśamasamyagdṛṣṭi, sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi, samyagmithyādṛṣṭi aura mithyādṛṣṭi jīva hote haiṃ || 144 ||
jinendra devake dvārā upadiṣṭa chaha dravya, pāṃca astikāya aura nau padārthoṃkā ājñā athavā adhigama se śraddhāna karaneko samyaktva kahate haiṃ | vaha samyaktva jinake pāyā jātā hai unheṃ samyagdṛṣṭi kahate haiṃ | darśanamohakā sarvathā kṣaya ho jānepara jo nirmala tattvaśraddhāna hotā hai vaha kṣāyikasamyaktva kahā jātā hai | yaha kṣāyikasamyaktva jina jīvoṃke pāyā jātā hai unheṃ kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭi samajhanā cāhiye | samyaktvamohanīya prakṛtike udayase jo cala, malina aura agāḍha śraddhāna hotā hai use vedakasamyagdarśana kahate haiṃ| vaha jina jīvoṃke pāyā jātā hai ve vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi kahe jāte haiṃ | jisa prakāra malina jalameṃ nirmalīke ḍālane se kīcaḍa़ nīce baiṭha jātā hai aura jala svaccha ho jātā hai usī prakāra darśanamohanīya ke upaśamase jo nirmala tattvaśraddhāna hotā hai vaha upaśamasamyagdarśana kahalātā hai | vaha jina jīvoṃke pāyā jātā hai unheṃ aupaśamikasamyagdṛṣṭi jānanā cāhiye | samyagmithyātva prakṛtike udayase jo samyaktva aura mithyātvarūpa milā huā tattvaśraddhāna hotā hai use samyagmithyātva tathā usase saṃyukta jīvako samyagmithyādṛṣṭi samajhanā cāhiye | upaśamasamyaktvake kālameṃ kamase kama eka samaya aura adhikase adhika chaha āvalī pramāṇa kālake śeṣa rahanepara kisī eka anantānubandhīkā udaya ā jānese jisakā samyaktva naṣṭa ho cukā hai tathā jo mithyātva avasthāko prāpta nahīṃ huā hai use sāsādana samyagdṛṣṭi kahā jātā hai | mithyātyake udayase jina jīvoṃkā tattvaśraddhāna viparīta ho rahā hai unheṃ mithyādṛṣṭi samajhanā cāhiye |
aba sāmānya samyagdarśana aura kṣāyika samyagdarśanake guṇasthānoṃkā nirūpaṇa karane ke liye

khettāṇugameṇa duviho ṇiddeso ogheṇa ādeseṇa ya || 1 || kṣetrānugamakī apekṣā nirdeśa do prakārakā hai- oghanirdeśa aura ādeśanirdeśa || 1 ||
jina caudaha jīvasamāsoṃkā satprarūpaṇā nāmaka anuyogadvārase astitva jāna liyā gayā hai tathā dravyapramāṇānugamase jinakī saṃkhyākā pramāṇa jñāta ho cukā hai una caudaha jīvasamāsoṃke kṣetrasambandhī pramāṇakā parijñāna karāneke liye prakṛta kṣetrānugama anuyogadvāra prāpta huā hai | athavā jīva anantānanta haiṃ aura lokākāśa asaṃkhyāta pradeśarūpa hai, aisī avasthāmeṃ usa lokākāśameṃ samasta jīvarāśi kaise avasthita hai, isa śaṃkāke nivāraṇārtha yaha kṣetrānugama anuyogadvāra prāpta huā hai| yahāṃ prārambhameṃ kṣetrakā nikṣepa kiyā jātā hai- vaha nikṣepa nāma, sthāpanā, dravya aura bhāvake bhedase cāra prakārakā hai | anya kāraṇoṃkī apekṣā na karake kevala apane āpameṃ pravṛtta hue 'kṣetra' isa śabdakā nāma nāmakṣetra hai | tadākāra yā atadākāra dravyameṃ 'yaha kṣetra hai' aisī jo kalpanā kī jātī hai use sthāpanākṣetra kahate haiṃ|
dravyakṣetra do prakārakā hai- āgamadravyakṣetra aura noāgamadravyakṣetra | unameṃ jo kṣetraprābhṛtakā jānakāra hai, parantu vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase rahita hai use āgamadravyakṣetra kahā jātā hai| noāgamadravyakṣetra tīna prakārakā hai- jñāyakaśarīra, bhāvī aura tadvyatirikta | inameṃse jñāyakaśarīra tīna prakārakā hai- bhāvī jñāyakaśarīra, vartamāna jñāyakaśarīra aura atīta jñāyakaśarīra | inameṃse atīta jñāyakaśarīra bhī cyuta, cyāvita aura tyaktake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| jo āgāmī kālameṃ kṣetraviṣayaka śāstrako jānegā use bhāvī noāgamadravyakṣetra kahate haiṃ | jñāyakaśarīra aura bhāvīse bhinna jo tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyakṣetra hai vaha karmadravyakṣetra aura nokarmadravyakṣetrake bhedase do prakārakā hai | unameṃse jñānāvaraṇādi āṭha prakārake karmadravyako tadvyatirikta noāgamakarmadravyakṣetra kahate haiṃ| nokarmadravyakṣetra aupacārika aura pāramārthikake bhedase do prakārakā hai| unameṃse lokameṃ prasiddha śaktikṣetra evaṃ godhūma (gehūṃ) ādi aupacārika tadvyatirikta noāgama-nokarmadravyakṣetra kahalātā hai| ākāśadravya paramārtha tadvyatirikta noāgama-nokarmadravyakṣetra hai|
