phosaṇāṇugameṇa duviho ṇiddeso ogheṇa ādeseṇa ya || 1 || sparśanānugamakī apekṣā nirdeśa do prakārakā hai- oghanirdeśa aura ādeśanirdeśa || 1 ||
nāmasparśana, sthāpanāsparśana, dravyasparśana, kṣetrasparśana, kālasparśana aura bhāvasparśanake bhedase sparśana chaha prakārakā hai| unameṃ 'sparśana' yaha śabda nāmasparśana nikṣepa hai| yaha vaha hai| isa prakārakī buddhise eka dravyake sātha anya dravyakā ekatva sthāpita karanā sthāpanāsparśana nikṣepa hai| jaise- ghaṭa, piṭhara ( pātraviśeṣa ) ādikameṃ ' yaha ṛṣabha hai, yaha ajita hai, yaha abhinandana hai, ityādi | dravyasparśana nikṣepa do prakārakā hai- āgamadravyasparśana nikṣepa aura noāgamadravyasparśana nikṣepa | unameṃ sparśanaviṣayaka prābhṛtakā jānakāra hokara vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase rahita jīva āgamadravyasparśana nikṣepa hai| noāgamadravyasparśana nikṣepa jñāyakaśarīra, bhāvī aura tadvayatiriktake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| unameṃ jñāyakaśarīra noāgamadravyasparśana bhāvī, vartamāna aura samujjhitake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| jo jīva bhaviṣyameṃ sparśanaprābhṛtakā jānakāra honevālā hai use bhāvī noāgamadravyasparśana kahate haiṃ| tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyasparśana sacitta, acitta aura miśrake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| sacitta dravyoṃkā jo paraspara saṃyoga hotā hai vaha sacitta dravyasparśana kahalātā hai| acitta dravyoṃkā jo parasparameṃ saṃyoga hotā hai vaha acitta dravyasparśana kahalātā hai | cetana-acetanasvarūpa chahoṃ dravyoṃke saṃyogase niṣpanna honevālā miśra dravyasparśana unasaṭha (59) bhedoṃmeṃ vibhakta hai|
śeṣa dravyoṃkā ākāśa dravyake sātha jo saṃyoga hotā hai vaha kṣetrasparśana kahā jātā hai | kāla dravyakā anya dravyoṃke sātha jo saṃyoga hai usakā nāma kālasparśana hai| bhāvasparśana āgama aura noāgamake bhedase do prakārakā hai| sparśanaprābhṛtakā jānakāra hokara jo jīva vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase sahita hai usako āgamabhāvasparśana kahate haiṃ | sparśaguṇase pariṇata pudgala dravyako noāgamabhāvasparśana kahate haiṃ|
uparyukta chaha prakārake sparśanoṃmeṃse yahāṃpara jīvadravya sambandhī kṣetrasparśanase prayojana hai| jo bhūta kālameṃ sparśa kiyā gayā hai aura vartamānameṃ sparśa kiyā jā rahā hai usakā nāma sparśana hai| sparśanake anugamako sparśanānugama kahate haiṃ | nirdeśa, kathana aura vyākhyāna ye tīnoṃ samānārthaka śabda haiṃ| sparśanānugamakī apekṣā vaha nirdeśa oghanirdeśa aura ādeśake bhedase do prakārakā hai |

5. kālāṇugamo
kālāṇugameṇa duviho ṇiddeso ogheṇa ādeseṇa ya ||1|| kālānugamase nirdeśa do prakārakā hai— oghanirdeśa aura ādeśanirdeśa || 1|| .
kāla cāra prakārakā hai-- nāmakāla, sthāpanākāla, dravyakāla aura bhāvakāla | unameṃ 'kāla' yaha śabda nāmakāla kahā jātā hai| vaha yaha hai ' isa prakārase buddhike dvārā anya vastumeṃ anyakā āropaṇa karanā sthāpanā hai | vaha sthāpanā sadbhāva aura asadbhāvake bhedase do prakārakī hai| unameṃ kālakā anukaraṇa karanevālī kisī eka vastumeṃ anukaraṇa karanevāle vivakṣita kālakā buddhike dvārā āropa karanā, yaha sadbhāvasthāpanākāla hai| jaise- aṃkuroṃ, pallavoṃ evaṃ puṣpoṃ ādise paripūrṇa aura koyaloṃke madhura ālāpase saṃyukta citragata vasantakāla | usase bhinna (viparīta) asadbhāvasthāpanākāla jānanā cāhiye| jaise --- maṇiviśeṣa, geruka, miṭṭī aura ṭhīkarā ādimeṃ — yaha vasaṃta hai' isa prakāra buddhike balase kiyā jānevālā vasantakā āropa |
____ āgama aura noāgamake bhedase dravyakāla do prakārakā hai| kālaviṣayaka prābhṛtakā jñāyaka, kintu vartamānameṃ usake upayogase rahita jīva āgamadravyakāla hai | noāgamadravyakāla jñāyakaśarīra, bhāvī aura tadvyatiriktake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| unameṃ jñāyakaśarīra-noāgamadravyakāla bhāvī, vartamāna aura samujjhita bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| jo jīva bhaviṣyameṃ kālaprābhṛtakā jñāyaka hogā use bhāvī noāgamadravyakāla kahate haiṃ| jo amūrtika hokara kumbhakārake cakrakī adhastana kīlake samāna vartanā svabhāvavālā hai aise lokākāśa pramāṇa padārthako tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyakāla kahate haiṃ|
bhāvakāla āgamabhāvakāla aura noāgamabhāvakālake bhedase do prakārakā hai| inameṃ jo jīva kālaprābhṛtakā jñātā hokara vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase sahita hai usako āgamabhāvakāla tathā dravyakālase utpanna pariṇāmako noāgamabhāvakāla kahā jātā hai| ina kālabhedoṃmeṃse yahāṃ noāgamabhāvakālako adhikāra prāpta samajhanā cāhiye jo ki samaya, āvalī kṣaṇa, lava, muhūrta, divasa, pakṣa, evaṃ māsa ādirūpa hai |

6. aṃtarāṇugamo
aṃtarāṇugameṇa duviho piddemo ogheṇa ādeseṇa ya || 1 || antarānugamakī apekṣā nirdeśa do prakārakā hai- oghanirdeśa aura ādeśanirdeśa || 1 ||
nāma, sthāpanā, dravya, kṣetra, kāla aura bhāvake bhedase antara chaha prakārakā hai| unameṃ bāhya arthoko choḍa़kara apane āpameṃ pravṛtta honevālā ' antara ' yaha śabda nāma - antara hai | sthāpanāantara sadbhāva aura asadbhāva ke bhedase do prakārakā hai | bharata aura bāhubalī ke bīca umaḍa़tā huā nada sadbhāvasthāpanā- antara hai | ' antara ' isa prakārakī buddhise saṃkalpita daṇḍa, bāṇa va dhanuṣa ādikā nāma asadbhāva sthāpanā - antara hai |
dravya-antara āgama aura noāgamake bhedase do prakārakā hai| inameṃ antaraviṣayaka prābhṛtake jñāyaka tathā vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase rahita jīvako āgamadravya - antara kahate haiṃ | noāgamadravya-antara jñāyakaśarīra, bhāvī aura tadvyatiriktake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai | inameṃ jñāyakaśarīra bhī bhātrī, vartamāna aura vyaktake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai | taddvyatirikta noāgamadravya - antara sacitta, acitta aura miśrake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| unameṃse vṛṣabha jina aura sambhava jinake madhyameṃ sthita ajita jina sacitta tadvyatirikta dravya-antara hai | ghanodadhi aura tanuvātake madhya meṃ sthita ghanavāta acitta tadvyatirikta dravya-antara hai | ūrjayanta aura śatruṃjayake madhya meṃ sthita grāma va nagarādika miśra tadvyatirikta dravya-antara hai |
1
bhātra-antara āgama aura noāgamake bhedase do prakārakā hai | antara - prābhṛtake jñāyaka aura vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase sahita jīvako āgamabhāva - antara kahate haiṃ | audayika ādi pāṃca bhāvoṃmeṃse kinhīṃ do bhāvoṃke madhya meṃ sthita vivakṣita bhāvako noāgama bhāva - antara kahate haiṃ | yahāṃpara isī noāgama bhāva-antarase prayojana hai | usameṃ bhī ajīvabhāva - antarako choḍa़kara jīvabhāva antara hī prakṛta hai, kyoṃki, yahāṃpara ajīvabhāva - antarase koī prayojana nahīṃ hai | antara, uccheda, viraha aura pariṇāmāntaragamana ye saba samānārthaka śabda haiṃ | isa prakāra ke antarake anugamako antarānugama kahate haiṃ |
ogheṇa micchādiḍīṇamaṃtaraṃ kevaciraṃ kālādo hodi ? ṇāṇājīvaṃ paḍucca ṇatthi aṃtaraṃ, niraṃtaraṃ || 2 ||
oghase mithyādṛṣṭi jīvoṃkā antara kitane kāla hotā hai ? nānā jīvoṃkī apekṣā unakā antara nahīṃ hai, nirantara hai || 2 ||

bhāvāṇugameṇa duviho ṇideso ogheṇa ādeseṇa ya ||1|| bhāvānugamakī apekṣā nirdeśa do prakārakā hai- oghanirdeśa aura ādeśanirdeśa || 1||
nāma, sthāpanā, dravya aura bhāvakī apekṣā bhāva cāra prakārakā hai| unameṃ bāhya arthakī apekṣā na karake apane āpameṃ pravṛtta · bhāva' yaha śabda nāmabhāva hai| sthāpanābhāva sadbhāva aura asadbhāvake bhedase do prakārakā hai| unameṃse vītarāga aura sarāga bhāvoṃkā anukaraṇa karanevālī jo sthāpanā kī jātī hai usako sadbhāvasthāpanābhāva kahate haiṃ | usake viparīta asadbhāvasthāpanābhāva hai |
dravyabhāva āgama aura noāgamake bhedase do prakārakā hai| inameṃ bhāvaprābhṛtakā jñāyaka, kintu vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase rahita jīva āgamadravyabhāva kahalātā hai| noāgamadravyabhāva jñāyakaśarīra, bhāvī aura tadvyatiriktake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| unameṃ jñāyakaśarīra noāgamadravyabhāva bhāvī, vartamāna aura samujjhitake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| jo śarīra bhaviṣyameṃ bhāvaprābhūta paryāyase pariṇata honevāle jīvakā ādhāra hogā vaha bhāvī noāgamajñāyakaśarīra dravyabhāva hai| bhāvaprāmṛta paryāyase pariṇata hue jīvake sātha jo śarīra ekībhūta ho rahā hai vaha vartamāna noāgamajñāyakaśarīra dravyabhāva hai| bhāvaprābhṛta paryāyase pariṇata jīvake sātha ekatvako prāpta hokara jo pṛthagbhūta huā śarīra hai vaha samujjhita noāgamajñāyakaśarīra dravyabhāva hai | jo jīva bhaviṣyameṃ bhāvaprābhṛta paryāyasvarūpase pariṇata hogā usakā nāma bhāvī noāgamadravyabhāva hai| tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyabhāva sacitta, acitta aura miśrake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| unameṃ jīva dravya sacitta tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyabhāva hai| pudgala, dharma, adharma, kāla aura ākāśa ye pāṃca dravya acitta tadvyatirikta noāgamabhāva hai| kathaṃcit jātyantara avasthāko prāpta huā jo pudgala aura jīva dravyakā saṃyoga hai usakā nāma miśra tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyabhāva hai|

appābahuāṇugameṇa duviho ṇiddeso ogheṇa ādeseṇa ya || 1|| alpabahutvānugamakī apekṣā nirdeśa do prakārakā hai- oghanirdeśa aura ādeśanirdeśa ||1||
nāma, sthāpanā, dravya aura bhāvake bhedase alpabahutva cāra prakārakā hai| unameṃse 'alpabahutva' śabda nāmaalpabahutva hai | yaha isase bahuta hai aura yaha isase alpa hai, isa prakāra jo abhedasvarūpase adhyāropa kiyā jātā hai vaha sthāpanāalpabahutva hai|
dravyaalpabahutva āgama aura noāgamake bhedase do prakārakā hai| jo jīva alpabahutvaviṣayaka prābhṛtakā jñātā hotā huā bhī vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase rahita hai use āgamadravyaalpabahutva kahate haiṃ| noāgamadravyaalpabahutva jñāyakaśarīra, bhāvī aura tadvyatiriktake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| jo jīva bhaviṣyameṃ alpabahutvagrābhṛtakā jñātā honevālā hai use bhāvī noāgamadravyaalpabahutva kahate haiṃ| tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyaalpabahutva sacitta, acitta aura miśrake bhedase tīna prakārakā hai| unameṃ jīvadravyaviṣayaka alpabahutva sacitta tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyaalpabahutva kahalātā hai| śeṣa dravyoṃ viṣayaka alpabahutva acitta tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyaalpabahutva hai| ina donoṃkā alpabahutva miśra tadvyatirikta noāgamadravyaalpabahutva hai|
___ āgama aura noāgamake bhedase bhāvaalpabahutva do prakārakā hai| jo alpabahutvaprābhṛtakā jñātā hai aura vartamānameṃ tadviṣayaka upayogase bhī sahita hai use āgamabhāvaalpabahutva kahate haiṃ| jñāna, darśana, anubhāga aura yogādikako viṣaya karanevālā alpabahutva noāgamabhāvaalpabahutva kahalātā hai| ina alpabahutvabhedoṃmeṃse yahāṃ sacitta noāgamadravyaalpabahutvakā adhikāra hai |

9. jīvadvāṇa - cūliyāe paḍhamā cūliyā
di kāo paḍīo baṃdhadi, kevaḍikālaḍidiehi kammehi sammattaṃ laṃbhadi vā ṇa labbhadi vā, kevacireṇa vā kāleṇa kadi bhāe vā karedi micchattaṃ, uvasamaṇā vā khavaṇā vāsu va khetesu kassa va mūle kevaḍiyaṃ vā daṃsaṇamohaṇīyaṃ kammaṃ khaveṃtassa cāritaṃ vā saṃpūṇṇaṃ paḍivajjaṃtassa || 1 ||
samyaktvako utpanna karanevālā mithyādṛṣṭi jīva kitanī aura kina prakṛtiyoṃko bāṃdhatā hai, kitane kāla pramāṇa sthitivāle karmoṃke dvārā samyaktvako prāpta karatā hai athavā nahīṃ prāpta karatā hai, mithyātva karmako vaha kitane kālameṃ aura kitane bhāgarūpa karatā hai, tathā kina kṣetroṃ meṃ va kisake pādamūlameṃ kitane mātra darśanamohanīya karmakī kṣapaṇā karanevāle jīvake aura sampūrṇa cāritrako prāpta honevāle jīvake mohanīya karmakī upaśāmanā tathā kṣapaṇā hotī hai ? || 1 ||
pūrvokta anuyogadvāroṃke viṣama (duravabodha) sthaloṃke viśeṣa vivaraṇakā nāma cūlikā hai | yaha jīvasthāna sambandhī cūlikā nau prakārakī hai | vaha isa prakārase — sūtrameṃ jo ' kitanī prakṛtiyoṃko bāṃdhatā hai ' aisā kahā gayā hai usase prakṛtisamutkīrtana aura sthānasamutkīrtana nāmakī prathama do cūlikāoṃkī sūcanā kī gaī hai | usake āge jo vahāṃ ' kina prakṛtiyoṃko bāṃdhatā hai ' aisā kahā gayā hai usase prathama daṇḍaka, dvitīya daṇḍaka va tṛtīya daṇḍaka nāmakī tīsarī, cauthī aura pāṃcavīṃ ina tīna cūlikāoṃkī sūcanā kī gaī hai | āge isī sūtra meṃ jo yaha kahā gayā hai ki " kitane kālakī sthitivāle karmoṃke dvārā samyaktvako prāpta karatā hai aura kitane kālakī sthiti - vāle karmoṃke dvārā usa samyaktvako nahīṃ prāpta karatā hai ' usase utkṛṣṭa-sthiti nāmakī chaṭhī tathā jaghanya-sthiti nāmakī sātavīṃ cūlikākī sūcanā kī gaī hai | tatpaścāt jo sūtrameṃ ' kina kṣetroṃ meṃ va kisake pādamūlameṃ ' ityādi kahā gayā hai usase samyaktvotpatti nāmakī āṭhavīṃ cūlikākī sūcanā kī gaī hai | prakṛta sūtrake ' cāritaṃ vā saṃpuṣṇaṃ paḍivajjaṃtassa ' isa antima vākyāṃśameṃ jo ' vā ' śabdakā grahaṇa kiyā hai usase gati- āgati nāmakī nauvīṃ antima cūlikākī sūcanā kī gaī hai | ina sabakā viśeṣa vivaraṇa āge yathāsthānameṃ kiyā hī jānevālā hai |
kada kāo pagaḍīo baṃdhadi ti jaṃ padaṃ tassa vihāsā || 2 ||

1, 9-8, 3] jīvaṭṭhāṇa-cūliyāe paḍhamasammattuppattiparūpaṇā
[311 8. aṭṭhamī cūliyā evadikālaṭṭhidiehi kammehi sammattaṃ ṇa lahadi || 1|| itane kāla pramāṇa sthitivāle karmoke dvārā jīva samyaktvako nahīṃ prāpta karatā hai ||1||
yaha deśāmarśaka sūtra hai| isalie vahāṃ ina karmoke jaghanya va utkṛṣṭa sthitibandha, jaghanya va utkṛṣṭa sthitisattva, jaghanya va utkṛṣṭa anubhāgasattva, tathā jaghanya va utkṛṣṭa pradeśasattvake honepara jīva samyaktvako nahīṃ prāpta karatā hai; yaha abhiprāya grahaṇa karanā cāhie|

abhiprāya yaha hai ki jina prakṛti, sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśoṃkā bandha; sattva aura udīraṇāke honepara jīva samyaktvako prāpta karatā hai una prakṛti, sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśoṃkī yahāṃ prarūpaṇā kī jātī hai |
edesiṃ ceva savvakammāṇaṃ jāve aṃtokoḍākoḍiṭṭhidi baṃdhadi tāve paḍhamasammattaṃ labhadi ||3||

isa sūtrake dvārā kṣayopaśama, viśuddhi, deśanā aura prāyogya ina cāra labdhiyoṃkī prarūpaṇā kī gaī hai| pūrvasaṃcita karmoke anubhāgaspardhakoṃkā viśuddhike dvārā pratisamayameṃ śaktikī apekṣā uttarottara anantaguṇe hīna hokara udīraṇāko prāpta honekā nāma kṣayopaśamalabdhi hai| ukta kramase udīraṇāko prāpta hue una anubhāgaspardhakoṃke nimittase sātāvedanīya ādi puṇya prakṛtiyoṃke bandhakā kāraṇa tathā asātāvedanīya ādi pāpa prakṛtiyoṃke bandhakā virodhaka jo jīvakā pariṇāma hotā hai usakī prāptiko viśuddhilabdhi kahā jātā hai| chaha dravyoṃ aura nau padārthoke upadeśakā nāma deśanālabdhi hai| isa deśanā aura usameṃ pariṇata ācāryādikoṃkī prāptiko tathā tadupadiṣṭa arthake grahaṇa va dhāraṇa karanekī śaktikī prāptiko deśanālabdhi kahate haiṃ| samasta karmoṃkī utkṛṣṭa sthitikā ghātakara use antaḥkoḍākoḍi pramāṇa sthitimeṃ tathā unake utkṛṣṭa anubhāgako ghātakara use do sthānarūpa (ghātiyā karmoke latā aura dārurūpa tayā aghātiyā--pāpa prakṛtiyoṃ ke nīma aura kāṃjīrarūpa ) anubhāgameṃ sthāpita karanekā nāma prāyogyalabdhi hai|

328] chakkhaṃḍāgame jīvaṭṭhāṇaṃ
[ 1, 9-9, 119 tiryaṃca sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi saṃkhyāta varṣakī āyuvāle tiryaṃca tiryaṃca paryāyake sātha mara karake kitanī gatiyoṃmeṃ jāte haiṃ ? || 118 ||

ekendriyoṃmeṃ jāte hue ve bādara pṛthivīkāyika, bādara jalakāyika aura bādara vanaspatikāyika pratyekaśarīra paryāptakoṃmeṃ hī jāte haiṃ; aparyāptakoṃmeṃ nahīṃ jāte || 121||

1, 9-9, 137 ] jīvaṭṭhāṇa-cūliyāe tirikkhāṇaṃ gadiparūpaṇā

devoṃmeṃ jāte hue ve saṃkhyātavarṣāyuṣka sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi tiryaṃca bhavanavāsī devoṃse lagākara śatāra-sahasrāra takake kalpavāsī devoṃmeṃ jāte haiṃ || 129||

___ tiryaṃca samyagmithyādṛṣṭi saṃkhyātavarṣāyuṣka tiryaṃca jīva tiryaṃcoṃmeṃ samyagmithyātva guṇasthānake sātha maraṇako prāpta nahīṃ hote || 130 ||

tiryaṃca asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi saṃkhyātavarṣāyuṣka tiryaṃca jīva tiryaṃca paryāyake sātha marakara kitanī gatiyoṃmeṃ jāte haiṃ ? || 131 ||
ekkaṃ hi ceva devagadiṃ gacchaṃti || 132 || uparyukta tiryaṃca jīva marakara eka mātra devagatiko hī jāte haiṃ || 132 || devesu gacchaṃtā sohammīsāṇappahuḍi jāva āraṇaccudakappavāsiyadevesu gacchati ||
devoṃmeṃ jāte hue ve saudharma-aiśāna khargase lagākara āraṇa-acyuta kalpa takake kalpavāsī devoṃmeṃ jāte haiṃ || 133||
tirikkhamicchāiṭṭhī sāsaṇasammāiṭṭhī asaṃkhejjavāsāuvā tirikkhā tirikkhehi kālagadasamāṇā kadi gadīo gacchaṃti ? || 134 ||
tiryaṃca mithyādṛṣṭi aura sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi asaṃkhyātavarṣāyuṣka tiryaṃca tiryaṃca paryāyake sātha marakara kitanī gatiyoṃmeṃ jāte haiṃ ? || 134 ||

kadi tti sattavihā kadī-ṇāmakadī ṭhavaṇakadī davvakadī gaṇaṇakadī gaṃdhakadī karaṇakadī bhāvakadī cedi || 46||
___kṛti sāta prakārakī hai- nāmakṛti, sthāpanākṛti, dravyakṛti, gaṇanākṛti, granthakṛti, karaṇakṛti aura bhāvakṛti || 46 ||
inake arthakī prarūpaṇā āge svayaṃ sūtrakārake dvārā kī gaī hai, ataḥ yahāṃ unakā svarūpa nahīṃ nirdiṣṭa kiyā gayā hai | aba ina sāta kṛtiyoṃmeṃse kisa nayake liye kauna-sī kṛtiyāṃ abhīṣṭa haiṃ, isakī prarūpaṇā karaneke liye āgekā sūtraprabandha prāpta hotā hai

4, 1, 52 ) kadiaṇiyogaddāre ṇayavibhāsaṇadā
[ 523 ___ abhiprāya yaha hai ki ṛjusūtra sthāpanākṛtiko choḍa़kara śeṣa saba kṛtiyoṃko svīkāra karatā hai | ṛjusūtra naya śuddha aura aśuddhake bhedase do prakārakā hai| unameṃ yahāṃ aśuddha ṛjusūtra naya vivakṣita hai, kyoṃki, sthāpanā kṛtiko choḍa़kara anya saba kṛtiyāṃ usīkī viṣaya ho sakatī haiṃ | śuddha ṛjusūtra naya to arthaparyāyako viṣaya karaneke kāraṇa kevala bhāvakṛtiko hī viṣaya karatā hai, usako choḍa़kara vaha anya kisī bhī kṛtiko svīkāra nahīṃ karatā hai |
saddādao ṇāmakadiṃ bhāvakadiṃ ca icchaṃti || 50 || śabdādika naya nāmakṛti aura bhāvakṛtiko svīkāra karate haiṃ || 50 || isa prakāra ukta kṛtiyoṃkī nayaviṣayatākā kathana aba āge nikṣepaprarūpaṇāse kiyā jātā hai
jā sā ṇāmakadī ṇāma sā jīvassa vā, ajīvassa vā, jīvāṇaṃ vā, ajīvāṇaṃ vā, jīvassa ca ajīvassa ca, jīvassa ca ajīvāṇaṃ ca, jīvāṇaṃ ca ajīvassa ca jīvāṇaṃca ajīvāṇaṃ ca jassa ṇāmaṃ kīradi kadi tti sā savvā ṇāmakadī ṇāma ||51||
jo vaha nāmakṛti hai vaha eka jīvake, eka ajīvake, bahuta jīvoṃke, bahuta ajīvoṃke, eka jīva aura eka ajīvake, eka jīva aura bahuta ajīvoṃke; bahuta jīvoṃ aura eka ajīvake, tathā bahuta jīvoṃ aura bahuta ajīvoṃmeṃ jisakā ‘kṛti' aisā nāma kiyā jātā hai vaha saba nāmakṛti kahalātī hai || 51||
nāmakṛti uparyukta eka va aneka jīvājīvādi āṭhakoṃhī viṣaya karatī hai, kyoṃ ki, inase adhika bhaṃga sambhava nahīṃ haiṃ | ina āṭha bhaṃgomeṃ jisakā ‘kṛti' aisā nāma kiyā jātā hai vaha apane āpameṃ rahanevālī ‘kṛti' saṃjñā ādhārake bhedase āṭha prakāra aura avāntara bhedase karoḍa़oṃ bhedoṃko prāpta hotī hai | vaha saba nāmakṛti kahalātī hai|
jā sā ṭhavaṇakadī ṇāma sā kaṭṭhakammesu vā cittakammesu vā pottakammesu vā leppakammesu vā leṇakammesu vā selakammasu vā gihakammesu vā bhittikammesu vā daṃtakammesu vā bheḍakammesu vā akkho vā varāḍao vā je cāmaṇṇe evamādiyā ṭhavaṇāe ṭhavijjati kadi ti sā savvā ṭhavaṇakadī ṇāma ||52||
jo vaha sthāpanākṛti hai vaha kāṣṭakarmoṃ meṃ, athavā citrakarmoṃ meṃ, athavā pottakarmoṃ meṃ, athavā lepyakarmoṃ meṃ, athavā layanakarmoṃ meṃ, athavā śailakarmoṃ meṃ, athavā gṛhakarmoṃmeṃ athavā bhittikarmoṃ meṃ athavā dantakarmoṃ meṃ, athavā bheṇḍakoṃ meṃ, athavā akṣa yā varāṭaka; tathā inako ādi lekara anya bhī jo 'kṛti' isa prakāra sthāpanādvārā sthāpita kiye jāte haiṃ vaha saba sthāpanākṛti kahī jātī hai ||52||
sadbhāvasthāpanā aura asadbhāvasthāpanāke bhedase sthāpanā do prakārakī hai| inameṃ yahāṃ pahile sadbhāvasthāpanāke kucha udāharaṇa diye jāte haiṃ- nācanā, ha~sanā, gānā tathā turaī evaṃ vīṇā ādi bājoṃke bajāne rūpa kriyāyoṃmeṃ pravṛtta hue deva, nārakī, tiryaṃca aura manuṣyoṃkī kāṣṭhase nirmita

524 ] chakkhaṃḍāgame veyaṇākhaṃḍaṃ
[ 4, 1, 53 pratimāoṃko kāṣṭhakarma kahate haiṃ | vastra, bhitti evaṃ paṭiye ādipara nācane ādikī kriyāoṃmeṃ pravṛtta hue deva, nārakī, tiryaṃca aura manuṣyoṃkā jo citra khīṃcā jātā hai use citrakarma kahate haiṃ| pottakā artha vastra hotā hai | usase kī gaī pratimāoṃkā nāma pottakarma hai| kaṭa (tṛṇa), śarkarā (śakkara) va mṛttikā ādike lepakā nāma lepya hai | usase nirmita pratimāoṃkā nāma lepyakarma hai| layanakā artha parvata hotā hai| usameṃ nirmita pratimāoṃkā nāma layanakarma hai| śailakā artha patthara hotā hai | usameṃ nirmita pratimāoṃkā nāma śailakarma hai | gṛhoṃse abhiprāya yahāṃ jinagṛhādikoṃkā hai| unameṃ kī gaī pratimāoṃkā nāma gṛhakarma hai | abhiprāya yaha ki ghoḍa़ā, hāthī, manuṣya evaṃ varāha (śūkara) ādike svarūpase nirmita ghara gṛhakarma kahalāte hai | gharakī dīvāloṃmeṃ unase abhinna racī gaī pratimāoṃkā nāma bhittikarma hai| hāthīke dāṃtoṃpara khodī huī pratimāoṃkā nāma dantakarma hai | bheṃḍase nirmita pratimāoṃkā nāma bheṃḍakarma hai | ye dasa sadbhāvasthāpanāke udāharaṇa haiṃ |
' asadbhāvasthāpanākṛtike udāharaṇa akṣa aura varāṭaka ādi jānane cāhiye | ‘akṣa' śabdase dyūta (juā) ke pā~soṃ aura gāḍīke dhurākā tathā varāṭaka śabdase kauḍiyoṃkā grahaṇa hotā hai | upalakṣaṇarūpase yahāṃ stambhakarma, tulākarma, halakarma aura musalakarma ādiko grahaṇa karanā cāhiye | jisameṃ sthāpita kiyā jātā hai vaha sthāpanā hai| 'amā' arthāt abhedarūpase sthāpanā arthāt sadbhāva va asadbhāvarūpa sthāpanāmeṃ 'yaha kṛti hai' isa prakāra jo sthāpita kiye jāte haiṃ vaha saba sthāpanākṛti kahī jātī hai|
jā sā dabakadī ṇāma sā duvihā āgamado davvakadī ceva ṇoāgamado davvakadī ceva || 53||
jo vaha dravyakṛti hai vaha āgamadravyakṛti aura noāgamadravyakṛtike bhedase do prakārakī hai ||
āgama, siddhānta va śrutajñāna; ina śabdoṃkā ekahī artha hai | jo āptavacana pūrvāparavirodha ādi doṣoṃke samūhase rahita hokara saba padārthoṃkā prakāśaka hotā hai vaha āgama kahalātā hai| isa āgamase jo dravyakī kṛti hai vaha āgamadravyakṛti kahalātī hai | isa āgamadravyakṛtise bhinna noāgamadravyakṛti jānanā cāhiye | isa prakāra dravyakṛtike kṛtikī do bhedoṃkī prarūpaṇā karake aba āge āgamabhedoṃke prarūpaṇārtha uttara sūtra kahate haiṃ
jā sā āgamado davvakadī ṇāma tisse ime aṭṭhāhiyārā bhavaṃti-dvidaṃ jidaṃ parijidaṃ vāyaṇopagadaṃ suttasamaṃ atthasamaṃ gaṃthasamaṃ ṇāmasamaṃ ghosasamaṃ ||54 ||
jo vaha āgamase dravyakṛti hai usake ye arthādhikāra haiṃ- sthita, jita, parijita, vācanopagata, sūtrasama, arthasama, granthasama, nāmasama aura ghoṣasama || 54 ||
__ ye āgamake nau adhikāra haiṃ| inameṃ jo puruṣa vṛddha va vyādhipīḍitake samāna bhāvaāgamameṃ dhīre dhīre saṃcāra karatā hai vaha usa prakārake saṃskārase yukta puruṣa aura vaha bhāvāgama bhī

4, 1, 55 ]
kadiaṇiyogaddāre sudaṇāṇovajogā
[ 525
sthita hokara pravṛtti karanese- ruka ruka kara calane se - sthita kahalātā hai | jinakā artha naiḥ saṃgyavṛtti hai | abhiprāya yaha ki jisa saṃskārase puruṣa bhāvāgamameṃ askhalita svarūpase saṃcāra karatā hai usase yukta puruṣa aura vaha bhāvagama bhī 'jita' kahā jātā hai | jisa jisa viṣaya meṃ praśna kiyā jātā hai usa usameṃ atiśaya śīghratāpūrvaka pravṛttikā nāma paricita hai | abhiprāya yaha ki kramase, akramase aura anubhayasvarūpase bhāvāgamarūpī samudrameṃ machalīke samāna atyanta caṃcalatāpūrṇa pravṛtti karanevālā prāṇī aura vaha bhāvāgama bhī paricita kahā jātā hai |
śiṣyoṃke paḍha़ānekā nāma vācanā hai | vaha cāra prakāra hai nandā, bhadrā, jayā aura saumyā | inameṃ anya darśanoṃko pūrvapakṣa rūpase sthāpita karake unakā nirākaraṇa karate hue apane pakṣako sthāpita karanevālī vyākhyā nandā kahalātī hai | yuktiyoṃ dvārā samādhāna karake pūrvāpara virodhakā parihāra karate hue siddhāntameṃ sthita samasta padārthoṃkī vyākhyākā nāma bhadrā hai | pūrvāparavirodha ke parihārake vinā siddhāntake arthoṃkā kathana karanā, yaha jayā vācanā kahalātī hai | kahīṃ kahīṃ skhalanapūrṇa vṛttise jo vyākhyā kī jātī hai vaha saumyā vācanā kahī jātī hai | ina cāra prakārakī vācanāoṃ ko prāpta huā āgama vācanopagata kahalātā hai | abhiprāya yaha hai ki jo dūsaroṃko jñāna karāneke liye samartha hotā hai use vācanopagata jānanā cāhiye | isa āgamārthakā vyākhyāna karanevāloṃko aura sunanevāloṃko bhī dravya, kṣetra, kāla aura bhāva ina cāroṃkā śuddhipūrvakahī karanemeṃ aura sunanemeṃ pravṛtta honā cāhiye |
tīrthaṃkara jinendrake mukha se nikale hue bījapadako sūtra kahate haiṃ | usa sūtrake sātha utpanna hokara jo śrutajñāna gaṇadhara devameṃ avasthita hotā hai usakā nāma sūtrasama hai | bāraha aṃgoṃkā viṣaya artha kahalātā hai, usa arthake sātha jo āgama rahatā hai use arthasama kahate haiṃ | abhiprāya isakā yaha hai ki dravyasūtrake dhāraka ācāryoṃkī apekṣā na karake saṃyamake nimittase utpanna hue śrutajñānāvaraṇake kṣayopaśamase jo dvādaśāṃga śruta svayaṃbuddhoṃko prāpta hotā hai use arthasama samajhanā cāhiye | gaṇadhara devake dvārā racā gayā dravyaśruta grantha kahalātā hai, usake sātha jo dvādaśāṃgaśruta bodhatabuddha ācāryoṃ meṃ avasthita rahatā hai usakā nāma granthasama hai | 'nānā minoti' isa nirūktike anusāra jo aneka prakārase arthakā pariccheda na karatā jo jānatā hai use nāma kahate haiṃ | abhiprāya yaha eka ādi akṣarako lekara bāraha aṃgoṃsambandhī anuyogoṃke madhya meṃ sthita dravyaśrutajñānake samasta bhedoṃko nāma samajhanā cāhiye | usa nāmake sātha jo śeṣa ācāryoṃ meṃ śrutajñāna utpanna ghoṣakā artha anuyoga hai, usa anuyogake sātha jo
va sthita hotā hai vaha nāmasama kahalātā hai | utpanna hotā hai vaha ghoṣasama kahalātā hai |
aba ina āgamoṃ viṣayaka upayogoṃkī prarūpaṇā karaneke liye āgekā sūtra kahate haiṃjā tattha vāyaṇā vā pucchaṇā vā paḍicchaṇā vā pariyaṭṭaṇā vā aṇupekkhaṇā vā - dhammakā vā je cāmaṇṇe evamādiyā || 55 ||

526] chakkhaṃḍāgame veyaṇākhaṃḍaṃ
[4, 1, 56 una nau āgamoṃviṣayaka vācanā, pṛcchanā, pratīcchanā, parivartanā, anuprekṣaṇā, stava, stuti, dharmakathā tathā aura bhī inako ādi lekara jo anya haiṃ ve upayoga haiṃ || 55 ||
anya bhavya jīvoṃke liye śaktyanusāra una nau āgamoṃviṣayaka granthake arthakī jo prarūpaṇā kī jātī hai vaha vācanā upayoga hai | ukta āgamoṃmeṃ nahīṃ jāne hue arthaka viṣayameṃ pūchanā, isakā nāma pṛcchanā upayoga hai | ācārya bhaṭṭārakoṃke dvārā kathita arthake niścaya karanekā nāma praticchanā upayoga hai | grahaṇa kiyā huā artha vismṛta na ho jāve, etadartha vāra vāra bhāvāgamakā pariśīlana karanā; yaha parivartanā upayoga kahalātā hai | karmokī nirjarāke liye pūrṇa rūpase hṛdayaṃgama kiye gaye śrutajñānake pariśīlana karanekā nāma anuprekṣaṇā upayoga hai | saba aṃgoṃke viṣayakī pradhānatāse bāraha aṃgoṃke upasaṃhāra karaneko stava kahate haiṃ| isameṃ jo vācanā, pṛcchanā, parivartanā aura anuprekṣaṇā svarūpa upayoga hotā hai use bhī upacārase stava kahā jātā hai| bāraha aṃgoṃmeṃ eka aṃgake upasaṃhārakā nāma stuti hai| sātha hī usameṃ jo upayoga hotā hai vaha use bhī stuti hī jānanā cāhiye | eka aṃgake eka adhikārake upasaṃhāra aura tadviṣayaka upayogakā nāma dharmakathā hai| . 'inako ādi lekara aura bhī jo anya haiṃ' aisā 'sūtrameṃ' kahanepara usase anya jo kṛti va vedanā ādi adhikāra haiṃ unake upasaṃhāra viṣayaka upayogoṃkā bhī grahaṇa karanā cāhiye | ' upayoga' śabda yadyapi sūtrameṃ nahīṃ hai to bhī arthāpattise usakā yahāṃ adhyāhāra karanā cāhiye | isa prakāra yahāṃ ye āṭha śrutajñānopayoga kahe gaye haiṃ|
__ yahāṃ kṛti anuyogadvāra prakṛta hai| tadviṣayaka ina upayogoṃko isa prakāra samajhanā cāhiye- anya jīvoṃke liye kṛtike arthakī prarūpaṇā karanā, vācanā kahalātī hai| kṛtiviṣayaka ajñāta arthaka viṣayameṃ pūchanekā nāma pṛcchanā hai | tadviṣayaka prarūpita kiye jānevāle arthakā niścaya karaneko pratīcchanā kahate haiṃ| vismaraṇa na hone deneke liye vāra vāra kṛtike arthakā pariśīlana karanā, parivartanā kahalātī hai | karmanirjarāke liye sāṃgībhūta kṛtikā punaḥ punaḥ vicāra karanā anuprekṣaṇā kahī jātī hai | kṛtike upasaṃhārake samasta anuyogadvāroṃviṣaya upayogakā nāma stava hai | kṛtike eka anuyogadvāra viṣayaka upayogakā nāma stuti hai | eka mārgaṇāviṣayaka upayoga dharmakathā kahalātā hai | isa prakāra ye kṛtiviṣayaka āṭha upayoga haiṃ |
ina upayogoṃse bhinna jīva cāhe śrutajñānāvaraṇake kṣayopaśamase sahita ho athavā usake vinaṣṭa kṣayopaśamavālā ho, vaha anupayukta kahalātā hai|
aba āge nayoṃke āśrayase anupayuktoṃkī prarūpaṇā kī jātī haiṃ
ṇegama-cavahārāṇamego aṇuvajuto āgamado davvakadī aṇeyā vā aṇuvajutto āgamado davvakadī || 56 ||
naigama aura vyavahāra nayakī apekṣā eka anupayukta jīva āgamase dravyakṛti hai athavā aneka anupayukta jīva āgamase dravyakṛti hai || 56 ||

saṃgaṇassa eyo vā aṇeyā vā aṇuvajuto āgamado davvakadī || 57 || saṃgraha nayakī apekṣā eka athavā aneka anupayukta jīva āgamase dravyakṛti hai || 57 || ujusudassa eo aṇuvatto āgamado davvakadī || 58 ||

jo vaha jñāyakaśarīra dravyakṛti hai usake ye arthādhikāra haiṃ- sthita, jita, parijita, vācanopagata, sūtrasama, arthasama, granthasama, nāmasama aura ghoṣasama || 62 ||
unameṃ dhīre dhīre apane viṣaya meṃ vartamāna kṛtianuyoga sthita kahalātā hai | vinā rukāvaṭake manda gatise apane viṣaya meṃ saṃcāra karanevālā kṛtianuyoga jita kahalātā hai | rukāvaṭake vinā ati śīghra gatise ghumāe hue kumhārake cakra ke samāna jo kṛtianuyoga apane viṣayameṃ saṃcāra karanemeṃ samartha hai vaha parijita hai | nandā-bhadrā ādike svarūpako prāpta kṛtiviṣayaka śrutajñānakā nāma vācanopagata hai | jina bhagavān ke mukhase nikalā huā jo bījapada ananta arthoṃke grahaṇa karane meṃ samartha hai vaha sūtra kahalātā hai; isa sūtra ke sātha gaṇadhara devoṃmeṃ utpanna hue kṛtianuyogadvārakā nāma sūtrasama hai | grantha aura bīja padoṃke vinā saṃyama ke prabhāva se kevalajñānake samāna jo svayaṃbuddhoṃ meṃ kṛtianuyoga utpanna hotā hai vaha arthake sātha rahane se arthasama kahā jātā hai| arahanta

[ 529 unameṃ gūṃthanerūpa kriyāse siddha hue puṣpamālā ādi dravyako pranthima kahate haiṃ| bunanā kriyāse siddha hue sūpa, ṭipārī, caṃgera (eka prakārakī baḍa़ī ṭokarī) cālanī, kambala aura vastrādi dravya bāima kahalāte haiṃ | vedana kriyāse siddha hue sūti (soma nikālanekā sthāna ), iṃdhuva (bhaṭṭī), kośa aura palya ādi dravya vedima kahe jāte haiṃ| pūraṇa kriyāse siddha hue tālābakā bāṃdha va jinagṛhakā cabūtarā ādi dravyoṃkā nāma pūrima hai| lakaḍa़ī, īṭa aura patthara ādikī saṃghātana kriyāse siddha hue kṛtrima jinabhavana, gṛha, prākāra aura stūpa ādi dravya saṃghātima kahalāte haiṃ| āhodima kriyāse siddha hue nīma, āma, jāmuna aura jaṃbīra ādi dravyoṃko āhodima kahate haiṃ| āhodima kriyāse yahāṃ sacitta aura acitta dravyoṃkī ropaja kriyāko grahaṇa karanā cāhiye | khodane rūpa puṣkariṇī, vāpī, kūpa, siddha hue taḍāga, layana aura suraṃga ādi dravya ṇikkhodima kahalāte haiṃ | ovellana kriyāse siddha hue ekaguṇe, duguṇe evaṃ tiguṇe ḍorā ādi dravya ovellima kahe jāte haiṃ | granthima va vāima ādi dravyoṃke udvelanase utpanna dravya udvelima kahe jāte haiṃ| citrakāra evaṃ vargoṃ ke utpādanameṃ nipuṇa dūsaroṃkī bhī kriyāse siddha manuṣya va ghoḍa़ā ādi aneka ākārarūpa dravya varṇa kahe jāte haiṃ | cūrṇana kriyāse siddha hue piṣṭa, piṣṭikā aura kaṇikā ādi dravyoṃko cūrṇa kahate haiṃ | bahuta dravyoṃke saṃyogase utpādita gandhapradhāna dravyakā nāma gandha hai| ghise va pīse gaye candana aura kuṃkuma ādi dravya vilepana kahe jāte haiṃ | ‘inako ādi lekara jo aura dravya haiṃ ' isa sūtra vacanase joḍa़kara va kāṭakara banāye gaye dvisaṃyogādi dravyoṃke astitvakī prarūpaṇā kī gaī hai|

ayogakevalīke jāneke ina donoṃ śaroroṃkī pariśātanakṛti hotī hai | isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki unake yogakā abhāva ho jānese bandhakā sarvathā vināśa ho cukā hai | ayogakevalīko choḍa़kara anya saba hī saṃsārī jīvoṃke ukta dono śarīroṃkī saṃghātana-pariśātana kṛti hī hotī hai, kyoṃki, saṃsāra meṃ sarvatra unakā āgamana aura nirjarā donoṃ pāye jāte haiṃ | ina donoṃ śarīroṃkī saṃghātanakṛti sambhava nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki bandha, sattva aura udayase rahita hue siddha jīvoṃke bandhake kāraṇoṃkī sambhavanā na rahanese unake ina donoṃ śarīroṃkā navīna bandha sambhava nahīṃ haiṃ | ye saba taijasaśarīra aura kārmaṇaśarīrarūpa mūlakaraṇakṛtiyāṃ haiṃ, aisā jānanā cāhiye |

538 ] * veyaṇaṇāmavihāṇaṃ
[ 4, 2, 3, 4 ___isa nāmake āśrayase yahāṃ vedanāke vidhānakī prarūpaṇā pūrvake samāna karanī cāhiye, kyoṃki, usase yahāṃ koī viśeṣatā nahīṃ hai | isa nayakī apekṣā nāmavidhānakī prarūpaṇā karate samaya āṭhoṃhī koṃkī vedanā, aisā kahanā cāhiye, kyoṃki, saṃgrahanayakī apekṣā 'āṭha' isa saṃkhyā jñānāvaraṇādi karmoke saba bheda sambhava hai| sūtrameṃ jo eka 'vedanā' śabda prayukta hai usase vedanāke saba bhedoṃkī avinābhāvinī eka vedanā jātikā grahaṇa hotā hai, kyoṃ ki inake vinā saṃgraha vacana sambhava nahīṃ hai| saṃgrahanayakā kāma eka sāmānya dharma dvārā avāntara saba bhedoṃkā saṃgraha karanā hai | abhiprāya yaha ki naigama aura vyavahāra nayakī apekṣā prakṛta vedanā āṭha prakārakī batalāī hai | kintu yaha saṃgrahanaya una āṭhoṃhī karmokī eka vedanā jātiko svīkāra karatā hai, kyoṃki, ukta saṃgrahanayameṃ abhedakī pradhānatā hai | yahī kāraṇa hai ki isa nayakī apekṣā āṭhoṃhī karmokī eka vedanā kahī gaī hai|

__ ṛjusūtranayakī apekṣā na jñānāvaraṇīyavedanā hai, na darśanāvaraṇīyavedanā hai, na mohanīyavedanā hai, na āyuvedanā hai, na nāmavedanā hai, na gotravedanā hai aura na antarāyavedanā hai | usakī apekṣā eka vedanīya hī vedanā hai || 3 ||

isa prakāra eka yogasthāna meṃ śreṇike asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāga mātra asaṃkhyāta spardhaka hote haiṃ || aṃtaraparūvaṇadā ekkkssa phaddayassa kevaḍiyamaṃtaraṃ ? asaṃkhejjā logā aṃtaraṃ || antaraprarūpaṇāke anusāra eka eka spardhakakā kitanā antara hotā hai ? asaṃkhyāta loka pramāṇa antara hotā hai || 184 ||
prathama spardhakake upara prathama spardhakake hī baḍha jānepara dvitīya spardhaka hotā hai | kāraṇa isakā yaha hai ki prathama spardhakakī prathama vargaṇā sambandhī eka vargase dvitīya spardhakasambandhī prathama eka varga vibhāgapraticchedoṃkī apekṣā duguṇā hī hotā hai |
vadayataraṃ || 185 ||

veṇāti tattha imāṇi tiṇṇi aṇiogaddārāṇi ṇādavvāṇi bhavaṃti || aba 'vedanākṣetravidhāna' anuyogadvāra adhikāra prāpta hai | usameṃ ye tīna anuyogadvāra jānane ke yogya haiṃ || 1 ||
nāma-sthāpanādike bhedase kṣetra aneka prakārakā hai | usameṃ yahāṃ noāgamadravyakṣetrasvarūpa lokākāśa prakṛta hai| 'lokyante jīvādayaḥ padārthāḥ yasmin asau lokaḥ ' isa niruktike anusāra jahāṃpara jīvādika padārtha dekhe jāte haiṃ- pāye jāte haiṃ- usakā nāma lokākāśa hai | āṭha prakārake karmadravyakā nāma karmavedanā hai | isa karmavedanākā jo kṣetra hai vaha karmavedanākṣetra kahā jātā hai | prakṛta anuyogadvārameṃ cūṃki isa karmavedanāke kṣetrakī prarūpaṇā kī gaī hai, ataeva isa anuyogadvārako vedanākṣetravidhāna isa nāmase kahā gayā hai | usameṃ ye tīna anuyogadvāra jñātavya haiṃ |
padamīmāṃsā sāmittaṃ appā bahue ti || 2 ||
ve tīna anuyogadvāra ye haiṃ- padamīmāṃsā, svāmitva aura alpabahutva || 2|| padamīmāṃsā ṇāṇāvaraṇīyaveyaṇā khettado kiṃ ukkassā kimaṇukkassā kiṃ jahaṇṇā kimajahaṇṇā || 3 ||
padamīmāṃsāke āśrayase jñānāvaraṇīya karmakī vedanā kṣetrakī apekṣā kyā utkṛṣṭa hai, kyā anutkṛṣṭa hai, kyā jaghanya hai, aura kyā ajaghanya hai ? || 3 ||
prakṛta padamīmāṃsā anuyogadvāra meṃ cūṃki karmavedanā sambandhī kṣetrake utkṛṣṭa - anuṣṭa padoṃ kā vicāra kiyā gayā hai, ataeva usakī 'padamīmāṃsā' yaha sārthaka saṃjñā hai | isameṃ ina padoṃkā
vicāra karate hue sarvaprathama yahāṃ jñānāvaraṇa karmavedanāsambandhī kṣetrake una viṣaya meṃ yaha pūchā gayā hai ki jñānāvaraṇīyakī vedanā kyā utkṛṣṭha hotī hai, kyā jaghanya hotī hai, aura kyā ajaghanya hotī hai |
isa pṛcchākā uttara āge ke sūtra dvārā diyā jātā hai

jo koī manuṣya yā paṃcendriya tiryaṃca saṃjñī hai, samyagdṛṣṭi hai, [athavā mithyādṛṣṭi hai ], saba paryāptiyoṃse paryāpta hai, karmabhūmi yā karmabhūmipratibhāgameṃ utpanna huā hai, saṃkhyāta varṣakī āyuvālā hai; strīveda, puruṣaveda athavā napusaṃkavedameṃse kisī bhī vedase saṃyukta hai; jalacara athavā thalacara hai, sākāra upayogase sahita hai, jāgṛta hai, tatprāyogya saṃkleśase [athavā viśuddhisa] saṃyukta hai, tathā jo utkṛṣṭa āvādhāke sātha deva va nārakiyoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko bāṃdhanevālā hai, usake ukta āyuke bāṃdhaneke prathama samayameṃ āyukarmakī vedanā kālakī apekṣā utkṛṣṭa hotī hai || 12 ||
yahāṃ sūtrameṃ jo ‘anyatara' padakā grahaṇa kiyā gayā hai usase avagāhanā, kula, jāti, evaṃ varṇādikī viśeṣatākā abhāva jānā jātā hai| devoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko manuṣya tathā nārakiyoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko manuṣya va saṃjñī paṃcendriya tiryaṃca bhī bāṃdhate haiṃ, isa abhiprāyako pragaṭa karaneke liye sūtrameṃ 'manuṣya aura saṃjñī paṃcendriya tiryaṃca' ina padoṃko grahaṇa kiyā gayā hai| devoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko samyagdṛṣṭi tathā nārakiyoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko mithyādṛṣṭi hī bāṃdhate haiṃ, isa bhāvako dikhalāneke liye 'samyagdṛṣṭi aura mithyādṛṣṭi' aisā nirdeśa kiyā gayā hai| devoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyu pandraha karmabhūmiyomeṃ vartamāna manuṣyoṃke dvārā hī bāṃdhī jātī haiṃ, parantu nārakiyoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyu pandraha karmabhūmiyoṃke sātha karmabhūmipratibhāgameṃ bhī vartamāna jīvoṃke dvārā bāṃdhī jātī hai; yaha abhiprāya 'karmabhūmi' aura 'karmabhūmipratibhāga' meṃ utpanna hue ina padoṃke dvārā sūcita kiyā gayā hai | 'saṃkhyātavarṣāyuṣka' se yaha abhiprāya samajhanā cāhiye ki deva va nārakiyoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko saṃkhyāta varṣakī āyuvāle hī bāṃdhate hai, asaṃkhyāta varṣakī āyuvāle nahīṃ bāṃdhate | devoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko sthalacārī saṃyata manuṣya hī bāṃdhate haiṃ, parantu nārakiyoṃkī utkṛṣṭa āyuko sthalacārī manuṣya mithyādṛṣṭiyoṃke sātha jalacārī va sthalacārī saṃjñī paṃcendriya tiryaṃca mithyādṛṣṭi bhī bāṃdhate hai; isa abhiprāyako pragaṭa karaneke liye sūtrameṃ 'jalacara aura sthalacara' aisā kahā gayā hai| jisa prakāra jñānāvaraṇādi śeṣa karmokī utkṛṣṭa sthiti utkṛṣṭa saṃkleśake sātha bāṃdhī jātī hai usa prakāra āyu karmakī utkṛṣṭa sthiti utkṛṣṭa saṃkleśa athavā utkṛṣṭa viśuddhike dvārā nahīṃ bāṃdhī jātī hai, isa abhiprāyako sūcita karaneke liye sūtrameṃ 'tatprāyogya saṃkliṣṭa aura tatyāyogya viśuddha' aisā nirdeśa kiyā gayā hai | āyukī yaha utkṛṣṭa sthiti cūṃki utkṛṣṭa ābādhāke vinā nahīṃ bāṃdhatī hai, isīliye yahāṃ ' utkṛṣṭa ābādhāmeṃ' aisā kahā gayā hai| cūṃki yaha utkṛṣṭa ābādhā dvitīyādi samayoṃmeṃ nahīṃ hotī.

[ 591
ṇiseyaparūvaṇadāe tattha imāṇi dube aṇiyogaddārāṇi aṇaṃtarovaṇidhā paraṃparovaṇidhā || 101||
niṣekaparūpaṇāmeṃ ye do anuyogadvāra haiṃ- anantaropanidhā aura paramparopanidhā || 101||
aṇaṃtarovaṇidhāe paṃciṃdiyāṇaṃ saṇṇīṇaṃ micchāiṭṭhīṇaṃ pajjattayāṇaṃ ṇāṇāvaraṇīyadaṃsaṇāvaraṇīya-veyaṇīya-aṃtarāiyāṇaṃ tiṇṇivāsasahassāṇi ābādhaṃ motūṇa jaṃ paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ bahugaṃ, jaṃ vidiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, jaṃ tadiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa tīsaṃ . sāgarovamakoḍākoḍiyo tti || 102||
___ anantaropanidhākī apekṣā paṃcendriya, saṃjñī, mithyādṛṣṭi paryāptaka jīvoṃke jñānāvaraṇīya, darśanāvaraṇīya, vedanīya aura antarāya ina cāra karmoṃkī tīna hajāra varṣapramāṇa ābādhāko choḍa़kara jo pradeśāgra prathama samayameṃ niṣikta hai, vaha bahuta hai, jo pradeśāgra dvitīya samayameṃ niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai, jo pradeśāgra tṛtīya samayameṃ niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai, isa prakāra vaha utkarṣase tīsa koḍākoḍa़ī sāgaropama taka uttarottara viśeṣa hīna viśeṣa hīna hotā gayā hai ||102||
jina jīvoṃne jñānāvaraṇa, darśanāvaraṇa, vedanīya aura antarāya ina cāra karmokī tīsa koḍākoḍi sāgaropama pramāṇa utkṛṣṭa sthitikā bandha kiyā hai unhīṃke usakā ābādhākāla tīsa hajāra varṣa pramāṇa hotā hai; usase kama sthitiko bāṃdhanevāle jīvoṃke vaha sambhava nahīṃ hai | isī liye yahāṃ ‘paṃcendriya' padase ekendriya va vikalendriyoṃkā, ‘saṃjñī' se asaṃjñiyoṃkā, 'mithyādṛṣṭi' se samyagdṛṣṭiyoṃkā aura ‘paryāpta' padase aparyāpta jīvoṃkā niṣedha pragaṭa kiyā gayā hai; kyoṃ ki, unake unakā ukta utkṛṣṭa sthitibandha sambhava nahīṃ hai | unakī utkṛṣṭa sthitiko bāṃdhanevāle jīvoṃke ukta ābādhākālameṃ ina cāra karmoṃke pradeśoṃkā nikṣepa (niṣekaracanā) sambhava nahīṃ hai, yaha abhiprāya sūtrameṃ 'ābādhā' ke grahaṇase sūcita kiyā gayā hai|
paṃciṃdiyāṇaṃ saṇṇīṇa micchāiṭṭhīṇaṃ pajjattayāṇaṃ mohaṇīyassa sattavāsasahassāṇi āvāhaṃ mottūṇa jaṃ paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ bahuaṃ, jaṃ bidiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, jaṃ tadiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa sattarisāgarovamakoḍākoḍi tti ||103 ||
paṃcendriya, saṃjñī, mithyādṛṣṭi evaṃ paryāptaka jīvoṃke mohanīya karmakī sāta hajāra varṣa pramāṇa ābādhāko choḍa़kara jo pradeśāgra prathama samayameṃ niṣikta hai vaha bahuta hai, jo pradeśāgra dvitīya samayameṃ niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai, jo pradeśāgra tṛtīya samayameṃ niṣikta hai vaha usase hīna hai; isa prakāra vaha utkarṣase sattara koḍākoḍi sāgaropama taka viśeṣa hīna hotā gayā hai ||
yahāṃ paṃcendriya ādi padoṃke grahaṇakā abhiprāya pūrvake hī samāna samajhanā cāhiye |

paṃciṃdiyāṇaṃ saṇṇīṇaṃ sammādiṭṭhīṇaṃ vā micchādiṭṭhīṇaṃ vā pajjattayāṇamāuastapuvtrakoḍitibhāgamābādhaṃ mottūṇa jaṃ paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇimittaṃ taṃ bahugaṃ, jaṃ vidiyasamae padesagaṃ ṇisitaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, jaṃ tadiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ; evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa tetīsa sāgarovamāṇi ti || 104 ||
592 ]
paṃcendriya, saṃjñī evaṃ samyagdṛṣṭi athavā midhyādṛṣṭi paryāptaka jīvoṃke āyu karmakī eka pūrvakoṭike tṛtīya bhāga pramāṇa ābādhāko choḍa़kara prathama samayameṃ jo pradeśapiṇḍa niṣikta hai vaha bahuta hai, dvitīya samaya meṃ jo pradeśapiṇḍa niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai, tṛtīya samaya meṃ jo pradeśapiṇḍa niṣikta hai vaha viśeṣa hīna hai; isa prakāra utkarṣase tetīsa sāgaropama taka vaha viśeṣa hīna viśeṣa hīna hotā gayā hai || 104 ||
cūṃki pūrvakoṭitribhāgake prathama samaya meṃ vartamāna saṃyata samyagdṛṣṭi jīvoṃke devāyukā tetīsa sāgaropama pramāṇa utkṛṣṭa sthitibandha tathā ukta tribhāgake prathama samaya meṃ vartamāna kinhīṃ mithyādṛṣṭi jīvoṃke nārakāyukā utanā mātra utkṛṣṭa sthitibandha sambhava hai, ata evaṃ isa apekṣāse sūtrameṃ ' samyagdṛṣṭi' aura 'mithyādṛṣṭi' padoṃko grahaṇa kiyā gayā hai |
paṃciṃdiyāṇaṃ saṇṇīṇa micchāiṭṭhīṇaṃ pajjattayāṇaṃ ṇāmā-godāṇaṃ bevāsasahassāṇi ābādhaṃ mottūṇa jaṃ paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ bahugaṃ, jaṃ bidiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇimittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, jaṃ tadiya samae padesaggaṃ ṇisitaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ; evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa vīsaṃ sāgarovamakoḍā koḍiyo tti || 105 ||
paṃcendriya, saṃjñī va mithyādṛṣṭi paryāptaka jīvoṃke nāma aura gotra karmoṃkī do hajāra varṣa pramāṇa ābādhāko choḍa़kara jo pradeśapiṇḍa prathama samaya meṃ niṣikta hai vaha bahuta hai, jo pradeśapiṇḍa dvitīya samaya meṃ niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai, jo pradeśapiṇḍa tṛtīya samaya meṃ niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai; isa prakāra utkarṣase bīsa koḍa़ākoḍa़i sāgaropama taka viśeṣa hīna viśeṣa na hotā gayā hai || 105 ||
paṃciṃdiyāṇaṃ saṇṇīṇa micchāiṭṭhīṇamapajjattayāṇaṃ sattaṇṇaṃ kammāṇamāuvavajjāṇamaṃtomuhuttamābādhaṃ mottūṇa jaṃ paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ bahugaṃ, jaṃ bidiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, jaṃ tadiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ; evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkassega aṃtokoḍākoḍiyo tti || 106 ||
paṃcendriya, saṃjñī va mithyādṛṣṭi aparyāptaka jīvoṃke āyuke vinā śeṣa sāta karmoṃ kī antarmuhūrta mātra ābādhāko choḍa़kara jo pradeśapiṇḍa prathama samayameṃ niṣikta hai vaha bahuta hai, jo pradeśapiṇḍa dvitīya samaya meṃ niṣikta hai vaha viśeṣa hīna hai, pradeśapiṇḍa tṛtīya samaya meṃ niṣikta hai vaha viśeṣa hīna hai; isa prakāra utkarṣa se antaḥkoḍa़ākoḍi sāgaropama taka viśeṣa hīna hotā gayā hai |

[ 593 paṃciṃdiyāṇaṃ saṇṇīṇamasaṇṇīṇaṃ cauriṃdiya-tīiṃdiya - bīiṃdiyāṇaṃ bādareiṃdiyaapajjattayāṇaṃ suhumeiṃdiyapajjattāpajjattāṇamāuassa aṃtomuhuttamābādhaṃ mottūṇa jāva paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ bahuaṃ, jaṃ bidiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, jaṃ tadiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa puvakoḍīyo tti || 107||
saṃjñī va asaṃjñī paṃcendriya, caturindriya, trīndriya, dvīndriya, aura bādara ekendriya ye aparyāptaka tathā sūkṣma ekendriya paryāptaka va aparyāptaka jīvoṃke āyu karmakī antarmuhūrta mātra ābādhāko choḍa़kara prathama samayameṃ jo pradeśāgra niṣikta hai vaha bahuta hai, dvitīya samayameṃ jo pradeśāgra niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai | tṛtīya samayameṃ jo pradeśāgra niṣikta hai vaha viśeṣa hīna hai; isa prakāra utkarṣase pūrvakoṭi taka viśeṣa hīna viśeṣa hīna hotā gayā hai || 107 ||
paṃciṃdiyāṇamasaṇṇīṇaṃ cauriṃdiyāṇaṃ tīiṃdiyāṇaṃ bīiṃdiyāṇaṃ bādaraeiṃdiyapajjattayāṇaṃ sattaṇṇaṃ kammāṇaṃ āuavajjāṇaṃ aṃtomuhuttamāvādhaṃ mottūṇa jaṃ paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ bahuaṃ, jaṃ bidiyasamae padesagaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, jaṃ tadiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ, evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa sāgarovamasahassassa sāgarovamasadassa sāgarovamapaṇṇāsāe sāgarovamapaṇuvīsāe sāgarovamassa tiṇṇi-sattabhāgā satta-sattabhāgā be-sattabhāgā paḍivuṇṇā tti || 108 ||
asaṃjñī paṃcendriya, caturindriya, trīndriya, dvīndriya aura bādara ekendriya paryāpta jīvoṃke āyu karmase rahita sāta karmoṃkī antarmuhūrta mātra ābādhāko choḍa़kara prathama samayameṃ jo pradeśapiṇḍa niṣikta hai vaha bahuta hai, dvitīya sayayameṃ jo pradeśapiṇḍa niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai, tṛtīya samayameṃ jo pradeśapiṇḍa niṣikta hai vaha usase viśeṣa hīna hai; isa prakāra viśeṣa hīna viśeṣa hīna hokara utkarṣase hajāra sāgaropamoṃke sau sāgaropamoṃke, pacāsa sāgaropamoṃke, paccīsa sāgaropamake
aura eka sāgaropamake cāra karma, mohanīya evaṃ nāma-gotra karmoke kramase sāta bhāgoṃmeṃse tīna bhāga (3), sāta bhāga (oṃ) aura do bhāgoṃ (3) taka calā gayā hai || 108 ||

706] chakkhaṃḍāgame vaggaṇā-khaṃḍaṃ
[5, 5, 71 yaha avadhijñānakā kṣetra nīcekī orakā nirdiṣṭa kiyā gayā hai| ukta deva avadhijñānake dvārā ūpara apane apane vimānake śikhara paryanta hī jānate haiṃ | unake avadhijñānake kālakā pramāṇa bramha-bramhottara kalpataka kramase asaṃkhyāta varṣa, palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāga, aura palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāga, mātra hai| brahma-brahmottara kalpase ūpara uparima praiveyaka taka ukta avadhijñānake viṣayabhūta kālakā pramāṇa kucha kama palyopama mātra hai |

ānanta-prāṇa taka kalpavāsī aura āraṇa-acyuta kalpavāsī deva pāṃcavīṃ pṛthivī taka tathā praiveyakake deva chaṭhī pṛthivī taka dekhate haiṃ || 71 ||
savvaṃ ca logaṇāliṃ passaṃti aṇuttaresu je devā | sakkhette ya sakamme rūvagadamaṇaṃtabhāgaṃ ca ||72||
anuttaroṃmeṃ rahanevāle jo deva haiṃ ve saba hī lokanālīko dekhate haiṃ| ye saba deva apane kṣetrake jitane pradeśa hoṃ utanī bāra apane apane karmameṃ manodravyavargaṇāke anantaveṃ bhāgakā bhāga denepara jo antima rūpagatapudgaladravya labdha ātā hai use jānate haiṃ || 72 ||
isa prakāra deśāvadhike viṣayabhūta dravya-kṣetrādikā nirūpaṇa karake aba āge paramāvadhike viṣayabhūta ukta dravya-kṣetrādikī prarūpaṇāke liye āgekā gāthāsūtra prāpta hotā hai
paramohi asaṃkhejjāṇi logamettāṇi samayakālo du | rūvagada lahai dav khettovamaagaṇijīvehi || 73 ||
paramāvadhijñānakā kṣetra asaṃkhyāta ghanaloka pramāṇa aura usakā samayarūpa kāla bhī asaṃkhyāta loka pramāṇa hai | vaha dravyakī apekṣā kṣetropama agnikāyika jīvoṃke dvārā paricchinna hokara prāpta hue rūpagata dravyako jānatā hai || 73 ||
yaha paramāvadhijñāna saṃyatoṃke hī hotā hai, asaṃyatoṃke nahīṃ hotā tathā usakā dhāraka jīva mithyātva evaṃ asaṃyatabhāvako kabhī bhī nahīṃ prāpta hotā hai| isase yaha bhī samajhanā cāhiye ki paramāvadhi jñānī jīva mara karake devoṃmeṃ bhī nahīṃ hotā hai, kyoṃki, vahāṃ saṃyamakā abhāva hai | usakā utkṛṣṭa kṣetra asaṃkhyāta ghanaloka pramāṇa tathā utkṛṣṭa kāla bhī asaṃkhyāta loka pramāṇa hai | kṣetrase abhiprāya agnikāyika jīvoṃke avagāhanāsthānoṃkā hai| isa kṣetrase jinakī tulanā kī jātī hai, una agnikāyika jīvoṃko kṣetropama jānanā cāhiye | unako śalākārūpase sthāpita kara unake dvārā paricchinna jo ananta paramāṇu samārabdha rūpagata dravya prāpta hotā hai vaha usake viṣayabhūta utkṛṣṭa dravyakā pramāṇa jānanā cāhiye|

[ 5, 4, 258 jaṃ vidiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ kevaḍiyā ? || 258 || abhavasiddhiehi aṇaṃtaguṇo siddhāṇamaṇaṃtabhāgo || 259 ||
jo pradeśāgra dvitīya samayameṃ niṣikta hotā hai vaha kitanā hai ? || 258 || abhavyoṃse anantaguṇā aura siddhoṃke anantaveṃ bhāga pramāṇa hai || 259 ||

jo pradeśāgra tṛtīya samayameṃ niṣikta hotā hai vaha kitanā hai ? || 260 || vaha abhavyoṃse anantaguṇā aura siddhoṃke anantaveṃ bhāga pramāṇa hai || 261 ||
evaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa chāvaṭṭhisāgarovamāṇi kammavidī || 262 ||
isa prakāra cāra samaya aura pāṃca samaya ādike kramase taijasaśarīrake chayāsaṭha sāgaropama kāla taka tathā kārmaṇaśarīrake karmasthiti kāla taka niṣikta pradeśāgrake pramāṇako jānanā cāhiye ||
aṇaṃtarovaṇidhāe orāliya-veubbiya-āhārasarīriṇā teṇeva paḍhamasamaya-āhāraeṇa paḍhamasamaya tabbhavattheṇa orāliya-ubdhiya-āhārasarīrattāe jaṃ paḍhamasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ bahuaṃ || 263 ||
anantaropanidhākī apekṣā jo audārika śarīravālā, vaikriyikaśarīravālā aura āhārakaśarīravālā jīva hai usī prathama samayavartī āhāraka aura prathama samayavartī tadbhavastha jīvake dvārā audārikaśarīra, vaikriyikaśarīra aura āhārakaśarīrarūpase jo pradeśāgra prathama samayameṃ niṣikta huā hai vaha bahuta hai || 263 ||
jaṃ vidiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ || 264 || jo dvitīya samayameṃ pradeśāgra niṣikta huā hai vaha viśeṣa hīna hai || 264 || jaṃ tadiyasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ || 265 || jo tṛtīya samayameṃ pradeśāgra niṣikta huā hai vaha viśeṣa hīna hai || 265 || jaṃ cautthasamae padesaggaṃ ṇisittaṃ taṃ visesahīṇaṃ || 266 || jo caturtha samayameṃ pradeśāgra niṣikta huā hai vaha viśeṣa hīna hai || 266 ||
evaṃ visesahīṇaṃ visesahīṇaṃ jāva ukkasseṇa tiṇṇi palidovamāṇi tettīsa sāgarovamāṇi aṃtomuhuttaṃ || 267 ||
isa prakāra utkṛṣṭa rūpase kramaśa: tīna palya, tetīsa sāgara aura antarmuhūrta taka vaha viśeṣa hīna viśeṣa hīna hotā gayā hai || 267 ||

siddhānta-śabda-paribhāṣā
anagāmī avadhi- jo avadhijñāna jisa bhava aura jisa kṣetrameṃ utpanna ho usase dūsare bhava aura dūsare kṣetrameṃ
sātha jāve, use anugāmī avadhijñāna kahate haiṃ | anubhāgabandha-baṃdhanevālī karmaprakṛtiyoṃke bhītara sukha-duḥkhādike phala denekī jo śakti paḍa़tī hai, use anubhāga
bandha kahate haiṃ | anabhāgabandhādhyavasāyasthāna- anubhāgabandhake kāraṇabhūta pariṇāmoṃke sthānoṃko anubhāgabandhādhyavasāyasthāna |
kahate haiṃ| antarmuhūrta- āvalīse ūpara aura muhūrtase nīceke kālako antarmuhurta kahate haiṃ| antaḥkoḍākoḍī- koṭise ūpara aura koṭākoṭise nīceke madhyavartī kālako antaḥkoḍākoḍī kahate haiṃ| apakramaṇakāla-vivakṣita jīvarāśi jitane samaya taka lagātāra utpanna na ho, utane kālako apakramaṇakāla
___ kahate haiṃ| aparyāptanirvṛti- aparyāpta jīvoṃke yogya aparyāptiyoṃkī nirvṛtiko aparyāptanirvṛti kahate haiṃ| aparyāpti- paryāptiyoṃkī ardhaniṣpanna avasthāko arthāt apūrṇatāko aparyāpti kahate haiṃ| apohā- jisake dvārā saṃśayake kāraṇabhūta vikalpakā nirākaraṇa kiyā jātā hai, aise īhājñānako apohā kahate haiṃ| abhyākhyāna- kaṣāyake vaśībhūta hokara aniṣṭa vacana kahaneko tathā asadbhūta doṣoṃke udbhāvanako abhyākhyāna ___ kahate haiṃ | araṃjana- eka viśeṣa jātikā miṭṭīkā pātra | ardhapudgalaparivartana- eka pudgalaparivartanameṃ jitanā samaya lagatā hai, usake ādhe samayako ardhapudgalaparivartana
kahate haiṃ | ardhapudgalaparivartanakā kāla bhī ananta varṣa pramāṇa hai| avagraha- jisake dvārā ghaṭādi padārtha jānaneke lie grahaṇa kiye jāveṃ, aise jñānako avagraha kahate haiṃ | avadhāna- anya padārthoṃse bhinna karake vivakṣita padārthake jānaneko avadhāna kahate haiṃ| yaha avagrahajñānakā
paryāyavācī nāma hai| avalambanā- jo jñāna apanī utpattike lie indriyādikā avalambana letā hai, aise avagrahajñānakā dūsarā nāma
avalambanā bhī hai| avalambanākaraṇa- uparitana sthitimeṃ sthita dravyakā apakarṣaṇa karake adhastana sthitimeṃ nikṣepaṇa karaneko
avalambanākaraṇa kahate haiṃ | avasarpiṇīkāla- jisa kālameṃ jīvoṃkī āyu, bala, buddhi aura śarīrakī uṃcāī ādi uttarottara ghaṭatī
